phrasalVerbs.ko: 편지나 소포를 (보통 우편으로) 보내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to describe time moving forward or passing, especially faster than expected.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 버스, 기차, 비행기와 같은 탈것을 타다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finally understand or realize something, especially after some time or effort.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어느 정도 시간이나 노력을 들인 후에 무엇을 결국 이해하거나 깨닫다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to avoid doing something you do not want to do, or to escape from an unpleasant duty or situation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 비밀이어야 할 일이 대중에게 알려지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to recover from something difficult, such as an illness, disappointment, or emotional pain
phrasalVerbs.ko: 질병, 실망, 감정적 아픔 등 어려운 일을 극복하거나 회복하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish something unpleasant as soon as possible so you don't have to worry about it anymore.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 불쾌한 일을 더 이상 걱정하지 않도록 최대한 빨리 끝내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish or successfully complete something, especially something difficult or time-consuming
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 전화나 다른 소통 수단을 통해 누군가와 연락이 닿다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone upset, annoyed, or bothered
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 속상하게 하거나 짜증나게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move from lying down or sitting to a standing position
phrasalVerbs.ko: 행사나 활동과 같은 무언가를 준비하거나 조직하는 것. 필요한 사람이나 재료를 모아서 하는 경우가 많음.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To give something to someone without asking for money; to make a gift of something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 비밀이어야 할 것을 알리다; 고의로 또는 실수로 무언가를 공개하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: When something gives in, it collapses, breaks, or stops working because it cannot handle any more pressure or force.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 저항을 멈추고 결국 다른 사람이 원하는 것을 하기로 동의하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To produce or release something such as a smell, light, heat, or feeling.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 냄새, 빛, 열, 느낌 등을 내뿜거나 방출하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give something to each person in a group; to distribute.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 남은 것이 없어서 다 써버리거나 작동을 멈추다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop owning, doing, or keeping something; to let go of something you have
phrasalVerbs.ko: 너무 어렵거나 성공하지 못할 것 같아서 무엇인가를 시도하는 것을 멈추는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to look at something quickly, especially to get a general idea of what it is about
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 내용을 대략적으로 파악하기 위해 무언가를 빠르게 훑어보다

phrasalVerbs.definition: If someone's eyes glaze over, they suddenly look bored or not interested, usually because they are tired or not paying attention.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가의 눈이 멍해진다면, 그들은 갑자기 지루해 보이거나 관심이 없어 보이며, 보통 피곤하거나 집중하지 않을 때 그렇다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move smoothly, quietly, and effortlessly past someone or something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가 곁을 부드럽고 조용하며 수월하게 지나가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to avoid talking about the details of something or to make something seem less important or serious than it really is
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것의 세부사항을 말하는 것을 피하거나 실제보다 덜 중요하거나 심각하게 보이도록 하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep biting or chewing something repeatedly, or to make someone feel worried or anxious for a long time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 반복적으로 갉거나 물어뜯다, 또는 오랫동안 누군가를 걱정하거나 불안하게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start or continue doing something, especially in a particular way or method
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정한 방식이나 방법으로 무언가를 시작하거나 계속하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to try to catch, follow, or get someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 잡으려고 시도하다, 따라가다, 얻으려고 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to oppose, disagree with, or act in a way that is not the same as someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 반대하거나, 동의하지 않거나, 누군가 또는 무언가와 다르게 행동하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to continue or make progress with something over time
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가의 의견이나 계획에 자주 반박이나 질문 없이 동의하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To avoid or bypass someone or something, especially if it is an obstacle or problem.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람들 사이에 전해지다; 특히 정보나 뉴스가 널리 퍼지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to disappear, leave, or stop existing
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사라지다, 없어지다, 존재하지 않게 되다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to use a particular name or title that people call you
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 규칙, 지침, 지시에 따라 행동하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be swallowed, eaten, or accepted by someone's stomach, especially when talking about food or medicine.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 양, 수준, 가치가 줄어들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to choose or prefer someone or something because you like them or it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇을 좋아해서 선택하거나 선호하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start discussing or explaining something in detail
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 직업, 사업, 또는 학문 분야에 종사하기 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: If something electrical or mechanical goes off, it stops working or turns off suddenly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정한 방식으로 일어나다, 특히 성공적으로 또는 계획대로.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to continue doing something, or to move forward to a place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 작동을 시작하다; 켜지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: When something such as a light or a fire goes out, it stops shining or burning.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가와 사귀거나 연애 관계를 맺어 주기적으로 함께 시간을 보내는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to look at something or check it carefully to make sure everything is correct or understood
phrasalVerbs.ko: 모든 것이 올바르거나 이해되었는지 확인하기 위해 무언가를 꼼꼼하게 확인하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move by someone or something without stopping; to pass by.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇을 멈추지 않고 지나가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to experience or deal with something, especially something difficult or unpleasant
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 처음부터 끝까지 꼼꼼하게 살펴보거나 확인하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to attend or visit a place or event, such as a school, meeting, or other location.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 학교, 모임 등 장소나 행사에 참석하거나 방문하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To use a different name so that people know you by it, often for privacy or professional reasons.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 물속으로 표면 아래로 사라지다; 재정적으로 파산하다, 실패하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move or climb to a higher place or level
phrasalVerbs.ko: 불에 의해 빠르게 파괴되다; 완전히 타버리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to match, look good together, or be a suitable combination with something else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 것 대신 하나를 선택하거나 고르다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to eat something very quickly and completely
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 매우 빠르고 완전히 먹다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remove something by digging or scooping it out, often leaving a hole or gap.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 파내거나 긁어내어 무엇인가를 제거하다. 종종 구멍이나 빈 공간이 남는다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To work very hard for a long time, especially when the task is boring or difficult.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 지루하거나 어려운 일을 오랫동안 매우 열심히 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To try to find something by feeling with your hands because you cannot see it easily.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 잘 보이지 않아 손으로 더듬으며 무언가를 찾으려 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To gross someone out means to make them feel very disgusted or sick because something is unpleasant, dirty, or disturbing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 역겹게 하다란 어떤 불쾌하고 더럽거나 불안한 것으로 인해 매우 역겹거나 메스껍게 만드는 것을 의미합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To slowly cover something as plants or vegetation spread on it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 식물이나 풀 등이 퍼져 천천히 무언가를 덮다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To change from being a child to being an adult; to become more mature.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어린이에서 어른이 되다; 더 성숙해지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To help someone find the right way or make the right decision by giving advice or direction.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 조언이나 방향을 제시하여 누군가가 올바른 길을 찾거나 올바른 결정을 내리도록 돕다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to shoot someone, usually with a gun, especially in a violent or sudden way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 (보통 총으로) 갑자기 혹은 폭력적으로 쏴 죽이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone remember or learn something by repeating it many times.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 여러 번 반복해서 누군가가 기억하거나 배우도록 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To discuss something in detail and try hard to reach an agreement or solution, usually after a lot of debate or discussion.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 문제를 자세히 논의하고, 오랜 협의 끝에 합의나 해결책을 찾으려 애쓰다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To give something, like a possession or tradition, to someone in a younger generation, usually within a family.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 가족 내에서 주로 어린 세대에게 소유물이나 전통을 물려주다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give something to each person in a group.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 그룹의 각 사람에게 무언가를 나누어 주다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To give something to someone else, usually because they ask for it or you are required to do so.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 요청받거나 요구되어 무언가를 다른 사람에게 넘겨주다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To spend time in a place or with people, usually without doing anything special.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특별한 일 없이 어떤 장소나 사람들과 시간을 보내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep trying and not give up, even when things are difficult. It means to stay strong and patient during tough times.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 힘들어도 포기하지 않고 계속 노력하는 것. 어려운 시기에 강인하게 인내심을 갖는 것을 의미합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to hold something or someone tightly and not let go, often because you don't want to lose them or it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가나 누군가를 꽉 잡고 놓지 않는 것, 대개 잃고 싶지 않아서.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put something, like clothes or a picture, on a hook or hanger so that it is suspended above the ground.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷이나 그림 등을 걸이에 걸어서 땅 위에 매달아 놓다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To discuss something carefully and thoroughly in order to solve a problem or make an agreement.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 문제를 해결하거나 합의를 보기 위해 어떤 것을 신중하고 철저하게 논의하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take away someone or something, especially using force or a vehicle.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 힘이나 차량을 사용하여 누군가나 무언가를 끌고 가다, 데려가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop moving, usually a vehicle, in order to take a break or rest for a short time
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 차량이 잠깐 쉬거나 휴식을 위해 멈추다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To be wearing clothes or accessories, or to have something scheduled.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷이나 액세서리를 착용하고 있거나, 일정이 잡혀 있다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become covered with something (like mist or fog) so that it is hard to see clearly
phrasalVerbs.ko: 안개나 연기 등으로 덮여서 명확하게 보이지 않게 되다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop someone or something from going in a certain direction, often to prevent something from happening.
phrasalVerbs.ko: (어딘가로) 떠나다, 출발하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To be the leader of a team, group, or organization.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 팀, 그룹, 조직의 리더가 되다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To listen carefully until someone has finished saying everything they want to say.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 말하고 싶은 모든 것을 다 말할 때까지 주의 깊게 듣다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become more intense, active, or exciting, especially in a situation or competition
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 따뜻하게 또는 뜨겁게 만들다, 혹은 따뜻해지거나 뜨거워지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To surround or limit someone or something, making them feel trapped or unable to act freely.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 둘러싸거나 제한하여 갇히거나 자유롭게 행동할 수 없다고 느끼게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to assist someone with a task or in a difficult situation
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가의 일이나 어려운 상황을 도와주다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To surround someone or something closely and prevent them from moving freely; to make someone feel trapped or restricted.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 가까이에서 둘러싸서 자유롭게 움직이지 못하게 하다; 누군가가 갇혀 있거나 제한되어 있다고 느끼게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stay in a place where you cannot be found, usually because you are trying to escape from someone or something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가에게서 피하려고 발견되지 않는 곳에 머무르는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to suddenly increase the price, amount, or level of something, especially in a way that seems too much or unfair
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇(특히 옷)을 더 편하게 하거나 더러워지지 않게 위로 끌어올리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To depend completely on someone or something; if something hinges on something else, it will only happen or be successful if that other thing happens.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가에 전적으로 달려 있다; 어떤 일이 다른 것에 달려 있다면, 그 일이 있어야만 성공하거나 일어난다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To allow someone to use your property or your services in exchange for money; to rent something or yourself to others.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신의 재산이나 서비스를 돈을 받고 남에게 제공하다; 무언가나 자기 자신을 빌려주거나 임대하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fasten or connect something (like an animal, trailer, or equipment) to another thing so they can move together.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가(동물, 트레일러, 장비 등)을 다른 것에 연결하거나 묶어 같이 움직일 수 있게 하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to physically keep someone, an animal, or something in a lower position so they cannot move up or escape
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 더 나아가거나, 성공하거나, 발전하는 것을 막다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop yourself from showing or expressing a feeling or emotion.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 바로 사용하지 않고, 미래의 필요를 위해 따로 보관하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop someone or something from approaching or attacking; to delay or prevent something from happening for a while
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇을 하기 전에 보류하거나 기다리다. 더 생각이 필요하거나 더 좋은 시기를 기다릴 때 사용함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To wait; stay on the phone and not hang up. It's often used when you want someone to wait for a short time, especially during a phone call.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어려운 상황에서도 계속 버티고 포기하지 않는 것; 힘든 시기에 기다리거나 강인함을 유지하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to keep something and not give it away or get rid of it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 주거나 버리지 않고 계속 갖고 있는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to continue working or be strong enough for a period of time, especially when it is difficult or unexpected.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 팔이나 들고 있는 것을 누군가 또는 무언가를 향해 내밀다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To use something (like a secret, mistake, or threat) that you know about someone so you can control or influence them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 연기하거나 나중으로 미루는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remain strong or continue to cope well during difficult situations or stress
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 혹은 무언가를 지연시키다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stay in a place to hide or be safe, usually for a while
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어디에 숨어 있거나 안전하기 위해 (보통 잠시 동안) 한 곳에 머물다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to shout something loudly, especially to get someone's attention
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가의 주의를 끌기 위해 무언가를 크게 외치다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remove the inside part of something so that it becomes empty inside
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇의 내부를 제거하여 속이 비게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To focus your attention closely on a particular person or thing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 사람이나 사물에 집중해서 주의를 기울이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To become very interested in or start liking something so much that you want it all the time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가에 매우 관심을 가지거나 너무 좋아해서 항상 원하게 되는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to connect a person or device to a machine or system so it can work or function
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 기기를 기계나 시스템에 연결하여 작동하게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to get out of a vehicle or place quickly and often energetically
phrasalVerbs.ko: 차량이나 장소에서 빠르고 종종 힘차게 내리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to interrupt or join a conversation, activity, or situation where you are not invited or welcome.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 초대받지 않았거나 환영받지 않는 대화, 활동 또는 상황에 끼어들거나 참여하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To play in a silly, noisy, or rough way, especially instead of doing something serious.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 진지하게 해야 할 일을 대신해서 장난을 치거나 시끄럽게 놀거나 거칠게 노는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To wash someone or something by spraying water from a hose onto them. People often hose down things or places to clean them or cool them off.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 호스로 물을 뿌려서 누군가나 무언가를 씻다. 주로 청소하거나 식히기 위해 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To bend your upper body forward and round your shoulders, usually because you are tired, feeling pain, or trying to see something better.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 피곤하거나 통증을 느끼거나 더 잘 보려고 상체를 앞으로 굽히고 어깨를 둥글게 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stay in a safe place for a period of time, usually to protect yourself or wait for something to finish
phrasalVerbs.ko: 일정 기간 동안 안전한 곳에 머무르며, 보통 자신을 보호하거나 무언가가 끝나기를 기다리는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to search for someone or something very determinedly until you find and catch them, usually because they have done something wrong or are difficult to find
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 매우 집요하게 찾아서 결국 찾아내고 잡는 것, 보통 잘못을 저질렀거나 찾기 힘든 경우에 사용함

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep something secret, especially to prevent people from knowing about something bad or embarrassing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 나쁘거나 창피한 일이 알려지지 않도록 무엇인가를 비밀로 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become completely covered with a layer of ice.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 완전히 얼음층으로 덮이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to enter or get involved in something where you are not wanted or where you do not belong, especially in someone else's private matters.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 다른 사람의 사적인 일 등, 자신이 원치 않거나 어울리지 않는 일에 들어가거나 관여하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To ask someone to join you for a social activity, often as a date or to spend time together outside of the usual environment.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 함께 사회적 활동을 하자고 요청하는 것. 종종 데이트나 평소와 다른 환경에서 시간을 보내기 위함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To solve or fix small problems or disagreements, especially so that everything can go smoothly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 모든 것이 순조롭게 진행되도록 작은 문제나 의견 차이를 해결하거나 바로잡다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To lift something up using a special device called a jack, usually to repair or check something underneath.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특수 장치인 잭을 사용하여 무언가를 들어올리는 것, 보통 그 아래를 수리하거나 확인하기 위함임.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something look or seem more lively, exciting, or attractive.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 더 생기 있게, 흥미롭게, 매력적으로 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to write something quickly so you don't forget it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 잊지 않도록 급히 적다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to quickly push yourself away from a surface or object and go down to the ground.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 표면이나 물체에서 재빨리 몸을 밀어내어 땅으로 내려가는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: If something jumps out, it is very easy to notice because it is clear, obvious, or different from everything else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 눈에 띈다면, 그것은 명확하거나 뚜렷하거나 다른 것들과 달라서 매우 쉽게 알아차릴 수 있습니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: If something juts out, it means it sticks out farther than the surface or edge around it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 튀어나와 있다면, 그것은 주위의 표면이나 가장자리보다 더 앞으로 나와 있다는 의미입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To suddenly fall to the ground, usually because of fainting, illness, or exhaustion.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 실신, 질병 또는 탈진으로 인해 갑자기 쓰러지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stay at a distance from someone or something, usually to avoid danger or trouble. Similar to 'stay away.'
phrasalVerbs.ko: 일반적으로 위험이나 문제를 피하기 위해 누구나 무엇에서 거리를 두는 것. '멀리하다'와 비슷함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to prevent someone or something from increasing, rising, or growing; to control or limit.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 음식이나 음료를 먹은 후 구토를 참거나 토하지 않도록 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make sure someone or something stays inside a place and does not go out.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가가 밖으로 나가지 않고 실내에 머물도록 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to not touch or go onto a particular area or thing
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정한 곳이나 물건을 만지거나 들어가지 않는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to allow someone to continue working in their job or in a particular position, instead of asking them to leave
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 계속 일하게 하거나 자리를 유지하도록 허용하다, 해고하지 않고

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop someone or something from entering a place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 어떤 장소에 들어오는 것을 막다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to continue to do something at the same level, speed, or standard; to not stop or let it decrease
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 밤에 잠을 자지 못하게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To spend time with someone in a relaxed way, or to move around from place to place without any special plan. It is similar to 'hang out.'
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가와 편하게 시간을 보내거나, 특별한 계획 없이 여기저기 돌아다니는 것. '어울리다'와 비슷한 표현.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to treat someone or something in a bad or unfair way, especially repeatedly and without respect
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것이 가장 좋은지 알아보기 위해 보통 편안하게 다양한 아이디어나 제안을 이야기하고 공유하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To break or force something open by kicking it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 발로 차서 무언가를 부수거나 억지로 여는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start to have an effect or begin to work, especially after a short delay.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 짧은 지연 후에 효과가 나타나거나 작동하기 시작하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To start or begin something, especially an event or activity. This phrase comes from football (soccer), where the game begins with a 'kick off.'
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 시작하다, 특히 행사나 활동을. 이 표현은 축구에서 유래되었습니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to force something out of a place by using your foot to kick it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 잘못을 해서 어떤 장소에서 내쫓다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cause something, like dust or a ball, to move upwards by kicking it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 먼지나 공과 같은 것을 발로 차서 위로 올리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to completely destroy or remove a group of living things, usually by causing their death, so that none or very few remain
phrasalVerbs.ko: 일반적으로 죽음을 초래함으로써 생물 집단을 완전히 파괴하거나 없애서 거의 남지 않거나 아예 남지 않게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to provide someone with all the clothes, tools, or equipment they need for a particular purpose
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 목적을 위해 필요한 모든 옷, 도구, 장비를 누군가에게 제공하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to treat something roughly, or to handle something in a careless way so that it may get damaged.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 거칠게 다루거나 부주의하게 다루어 손상될 수 있게 하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to accidentally hit or bump into someone or something, usually by mistake
phrasalVerbs.ko: 실수로 누군가나 무언가에 부딪히거나 치는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish or complete something quickly and easily, often because it does not take much time or effort.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 브랜드 제품을 불법으로 복제하거나 생산하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something stop working or to damage something so it cannot be used
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 세게 쳐서 기절시키다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something fall to the ground by hitting it accidentally.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 실수로 쳐서 넘어뜨리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone pregnant
phrasalVerbs.ko: 임신시키다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To start working very hard, especially when you should have been working harder before.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 전에 더 열심히 했어야 했을 때 아주 열심히 일하기 시작하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give in to someone’s authority or demands, even if you don't want to.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 원하지 않아도 누군가의 권위나 요구에 굴복하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to tie the laces on shoes, boots, or other clothing that uses laces.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 신발, 부츠, 또는 끈이 달린 옷의 끈을 묶다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To finally be in a particular place, situation, or condition, often without planning it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 종종 계획하지 않은 특정 장소, 상황 또는 상태에 결국 있게 되다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To drink or eat something eagerly using the tongue, especially used for animals.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 동물이 혀로 무엇인가를 열심히 핥아서 먹거나 마시다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to suddenly speak or act angrily towards someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가에게 갑자기 화를 내거나 공격적으로 행동하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To survive or continue to exist through a difficult situation or for as long as necessary.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어려운 상황을 견디거나 필요한 만큼 살아남거나 계속 존재하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To finally understand something or realize an idea after some time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 아주 꼭 붙잡다(주로 지지나 위안이 필요할 때); 또는 무언가나 누군가에 매우 관심을 가지거나 집착하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To find something funny and show it by laughing, often making fun of a person or thing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 재미있게 여겨 웃음으로 나타내며, 종종 사람이나 사물을 놀리는 경우가 많다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something seem less serious or important by joking or laughing about it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 농담이나 웃음으로 어떤 일을 덜 심각하거나 중요하지 않게 보이게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to create or officially state a rule, law, or principle that others should follow
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람들이 따라야 할 규칙, 법, 원칙을 만들거나 공식적으로 정하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To collect and keep something, like food or supplies, so you will have enough when you need it later.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 음식이나 생필품처럼 나중에 필요할 때를 대비해 미리 모아두고 저장하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to criticize or attack someone or something angrily
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 화나게 비난하거나 공격하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop doing something, especially if it is bothering or annoying someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 더 이상 줄 일이 없어서 고용을 중단하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to explain something clearly, usually by presenting the main facts, plan, or details in an organized way
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주요 사실, 계획 또는 세부 정보를 체계적으로 제시하여 명확하게 설명하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: If someone is laid up, they must stay in bed because they are sick or injured.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 병이나 부상으로 침대에 누워 있어야 할 때 사용합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone believe something that is not true, especially by pretending to like them or be interested in a relationship, when you do not really mean it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 실제로 관심이 없으면서 호감이나 연애 감정이 있는 척 하여, 누군가를 잘못 믿게 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To be in charge of a group, project, or activity; to act as the main person responsible for something. Synonym: 'head up'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 그룹이나 프로젝트, 활동을 이끌거나 주된 책임자가 되는 것. 동의어: '이끌다'.

phrasalVerbs.definition: When a liquid slowly escapes or seeps from a place where it is supposed to stay.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 액체가 머물러 있어야 할 곳에서 천천히 새어나올 때.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to rest your body on someone or something for support
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가에 몸을 기대어 지탱하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To be easily seen or very noticeable, especially because it is different or stands out.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇에서 갑자기 뛰어나오거나 빠르게 움직이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to forget or intentionally not take something with you when you leave a place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어딘가를 떠날 때 물건을 깜빡 잊거나 일부러 챙기지 않는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop doing something, especially for a while or before finishing
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇을 (특히 잠시 동안이나 완료하기 전에) 멈추다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To not include someone or something; to skip or omit them from a group, list, or activity.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇을 포함하지 않다; 그룹, 목록, 활동에서 빠뜨리거나 생략하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to disappoint someone by not doing what they expected or hoped for
phrasalVerbs.ko: 기대하거나 바라던 대로 하지 않아 누군가를 실망시키다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to allow someone or something to enter a place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 장소에 들어오도록 허락하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To tell someone a secret or reveal information that was supposed to be kept private.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 비밀을 말하거나 비밀로 해야 할 정보를 드러내는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to end or finish, especially when an event or activity is over and people are allowed to leave
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷의 솔기를 조정하여 크기를 더 크게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop putting so much pressure on someone or something; to be less strict or intense.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가에 너무 많은 압박을 가하는 것을 멈추다; 덜 엄격하거나 덜 강렬해지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make a surface flat and even, so there are no bumps or high areas.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 표면을 평평하고 고르게 만들어 울퉁불퉁하거나 높은 부분이 없게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to relax or rest in a place, usually doing nothing important.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 중요한 일 없이 한 곳에서 편하게 쉬거나 휴식하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put your body in a flat or horizontal position, usually to rest or sleep
phrasalVerbs.ko: 눕다 (대개 쉬거나 잠을 자려고 몸을 수평 자세로 누이다)

phrasalVerbs.definition: to exist or be found in something; to be the reason or cause of something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇에 존재하거나 발견되는 것; 무엇의 원인이나 이유가 되는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To rise into the air, especially when something like a rocket or plane leaves the ground.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 로켓이나 비행기 같은 것이 땅에서 떠올라서 하늘로 오르는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take something out of a place by picking it up, usually carefully
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 조심스럽게 들어서 장소에서 꺼내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone feel happier or more positive
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 더 행복하거나 긍정적으로 느끼게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something start to burn or to switch on a light so that a place becomes brighter
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가에 불을 붙이거나, 조명을 켜서 장소를 밝게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something brighter, or to become brighter or less dark
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 더 밝게 만들거나, 더 밝아지거나 덜 어두워지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to do gentle exercises or stretches to prepare your body for physical activity and to become more flexible
phrasalVerbs.ko: 운동이나 스트레칭 등으로 신체활동 전 몸을 준비하고 유연하게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To arrange for people or things to take part in an event or activity; to organize or schedule participants.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 물건이 행상 등에 참여하도록 준비하거나 조직하다; 참가자를 일정에 맞게 배정하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend a long time on something, usually because you are relaxing or enjoying it, instead of hurrying.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 서두르지 않고 보통 느긋하게 즐기거나 휴식을 취하면서 어떤 일에 오랜 시간을 보내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to connect or join things or people so they can work together or be related in some way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사물이나 사람을 서로 연결하거나 합쳐서 함께 일하거나 어떤 식으로든 관련될 수 있게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to secretly listen to a conversation that you are not supposed to hear
phrasalVerbs.ko: 들어서는 안 되는 대화를 몰래 듣다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To be able to forget or recover from something embarrassing or bad that you have done, so that people stop talking about it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 창피하거나 나쁜 일을 하고 나서, 사람들이 더 이상 그것에 대해 말하지 않을 만큼 잊거나 극복하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To continue to exist or to remain alive after someone or something else has gone or ended.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가가 사라지거나 끝난 후에도 계속 존재하거나 살아남다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend the rest of your life in a particular way or place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 남은 인생을 특정한 방식이나 장소에서 보내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be as good as something or someone expects; to fulfill expectations or standards
phrasalVerbs.ko: 기대나 기준을 충족하다; 기대에 부응하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To accept something difficult or unpleasant and continue your life despite it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어려운 일이나 불쾌한 일을 받아들이고 그럼에도 계속 살아가는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something more lively, fun, or interesting
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 더 활기차고, 재미있고, 흥미롭게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fill something or someone with as much as possible; to put a lot of things into or onto something or someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇이나 누구를 최대한 가득 채우다; 많은 것을 무엇이나 누구에게 싣거나 넣다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put someone or something in a safe place and lock it, so it cannot be taken or used by others
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 어떤 것을 안전한 곳에 두고, 자물쇠를 채워 다른 사람이 가져가거나 사용하지 못하게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to prevent someone from entering a place by locking the door, often used when workers cannot go to work during a strike
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 들어오지 못하도록 문을 잠그다. 주로 파업 중에 직원들이 출근하지 못하도록 할 때 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make sure a building, room, or object is securely fastened with a lock, usually to keep it safe or to prevent anyone from getting in
phrasalVerbs.ko: 안전을 위해 또는 아무도 들어오지 못하게 건물, 방 또는 물건에 자물쇠를 확실히 잠그다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to enter your username and password to access an account, website, or computer system.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 계정, 웹사이트, 컴퓨터 시스템에 접속하기 위해 사용자 이름과 비밀번호를 입력하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To disconnect yourself from a computer, website, or app, so that you are no longer signed in.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 컴퓨터, 웹사이트 또는 앱에서 로그아웃하여 더 이상 로그인 상태가 아니게 된다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take care of someone or something and make sure they are safe and well.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 돌보고 안전하고 건강하게 지내도록 하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to walk through a place to see what is there, often to explore or find something interesting
phrasalVerbs.ko: 장소를 돌아다니며 무엇이 있는지 살펴보다. 종종 탐험하거나 흥미로운 것을 찾기 위한 행동.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to direct your eyes toward someone or something, usually to see, check, or examine it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 보기 위해 시선을 돌리다, 보거나 확인하거나 조사하기 위해

phrasalVerbs.definition: to turn your eyes to another direction so you are no longer looking at someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 더 이상 보지 않기 위해 시선을 다른 방향으로 돌리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to try to find someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 찾으려고 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to try to find out more about something; to investigate or examine a problem, situation, or issue
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가에 대해 더 알아보려고 하다; 문제, 상황, 사안을 조사하거나 검토하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to look or behave like an older relative, usually a parent.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 부모나 조부모 등 나이 많은 가족을 닮거나 행동이 비슷하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To watch something happen without getting involved or taking part.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 참여하거나 개입하지 않고 무언가를 지켜보다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be careful and watch for possible danger or something important
phrasalVerbs.ko: 가능한 위험이나 중요한 것에 조심하고 주의하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to rely on or expect help, advice, or solutions from someone or something; to focus your attention on someone or something for support or guidance
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가에게 도움이나 조언, 해결책을 기대하거나 의지하다; 지원이나 안내를 바라며 누군가나 무언가에 주의를 집중하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to try to find information about someone or something, especially in a book, on the internet, or in a list
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇에 대한 정보를 찾으려고 하다, 특히 책, 인터넷, 목록에서

phrasalVerbs.definition: To admire or respect someone, often because you want to be like them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 존경하거나 우러러보다. 종종 그 사람처럼 되고 싶어서.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become more relaxed or to help your body or muscles become less tense
phrasalVerbs.ko: 더 편안해지거나 몸이나 근육이 덜 긴장하도록 돕다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To spend time relaxing and doing very little, usually in a comfortable way. This means someone is not being active and is just taking it easy. Synonym: 'lounge around'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 편안하게 거의 아무것도 하지 않으면서 시간을 보내는 것. 즉, 활동적이지 않고 그냥 쉬는 것을 의미한다. 유의어: '빈둥거리다', '뒹굴다'.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To send letters, documents, or packages to people using the post office.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 편지, 문서 또는 소포를 우체국을 이용해 보내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to go towards a place; to move in the direction of somewhere.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어디론가를 향해 가다; 어떤 방향으로 움직이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be able to see, hear, or understand something, often with difficulty
phrasalVerbs.ko: 상황에서 성공하거나 잘 해내다; 특정 분야에서 잘하거나 못하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to change or improve the appearance of something or someone
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇이나 누군가의 외모를 바꾸거나 개선하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to invent or create something, especially a story, excuse, or explanation that is not true; or to prepare or put something together
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다툼이나 오해 후에 다시 친구가 되다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To plan something in detail or decide how it will happen before you do it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 시작하기 전에 자세히 계획하거나, 어떻게 진행될지 미리 결정하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to keep going forward or continue without stopping, especially despite challenges or the passage of time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 도전이나 시간의 흐름에도 불구하고 계속 앞으로 나아가거나 멈추지 않고 계속하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to walk in a determined and confident way to a place, often as a group, especially into a public area where people can see you
phrasalVerbs.ko: 결연하고 자신감 있게 (종종 단체로) 사람들이 볼 수 있는 공개된 장소로 걸어가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To lower the price of something, usually in a store.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 상점에서 무언가의 가격을 내리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To check or cross out items from a list to show they have been completed or dealt with.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 항목이 완료되었거나 처리되었음을 나타내기 위해 목록에서 체크하거나 지우다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to show or draw the edges or limits of an area or space.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 영역이나 공간의 경계 또는 한계를 표시하거나 그리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to increase the price of something, usually to make a profit
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 이익을 위해 무언가의 가격을 올리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be important or have value for someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 중요하거나 가치가 있다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To separate and give a specific amount of something, usually by using a tool or container.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 일반적으로 도구나 용기를 사용하여 어떤 것의 특정 양을 분리하여 제공하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be good enough, or as good as someone or something else
phrasalVerbs.ko: 충분히 좋거나, 다른 사람이나 것만큼 좋다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To try to change or influence something that is not your responsibility, often causing problems. It can also mean touching or handling something that you shouldn't.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신의 책임이 아닌 일에 간섭하거나 영향을 미치려 하여 종종 문제를 일으키는 것. 또한 만지거나 건드리면 안 되는 것을 만진다는 의미도 있다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to arrange to see and spend time with someone, usually for a social reason.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 사교를 목적으로 누군가와 만나 시간을 보내기로 약속하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become more calm, relaxed, or less strict, often as a result of time or experience
phrasalVerbs.ko: 시간이나 경험의 결과로 더 차분해지거나, 느긋해지거나, 덜 엄격해지는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to heat something solid until it becomes liquid, usually so it can be reused or reshaped.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가 고체를 가열하여 액체로 만드는 것, 보통 재사용이나 재형성을 위해서.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To lose weight gradually, often so that it seems to disappear naturally or easily.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 체중이 점차 자연스럽거나 쉽게 사라지는 것처럼 줄어드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend time doing things that are not important or not serious; to waste time instead of doing what you should do. Synonym: 'mess around'
phrasalVerbs.ko: 중요하지 않거나 심각하지 않은 일을 하며 시간을 보내다; 해야 할 일을 하지 않고 시간을 낭비하다. 동의어: '빈둥거리다'

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a mistake or do something badly; to ruin or spoil something by accident.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 실수하거나 일을 망치다; 실수로 무엇인가를 망가뜨리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To walk or move around a place without any clear purpose or direction.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 뚜렷한 목적이나 방향 없이 장소를 거닐거나 돌아다니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: When something, like glasses or windows, becomes covered with tiny drops of water, making it hard to see through. This usually happens because of sudden changes in temperature or humidity. 'Mist up' is a more common way to say this.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 안경이나 창문처럼 어떤 것이 작은 물방울로 덮여서 잘 보이지 않게 되는 것. 주로 갑작스러운 온도나 습도 변화로 인해 발생합니다. 보통 ‘김이 서리다’라고 합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to join or combine with a group of people or things, or to add something so that it becomes part of a mixture
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 사물의 그룹에 합류하거나 섞이거나, 무언가를 추가하여 혼합물의 일부가 되게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to confuse things or people, or to put things in the wrong order by mistake
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사물이나 사람을 헷갈리거나, 실수로 잘못된 순서로 두다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to behave in a silly or playful way, often wasting time instead of doing something important
phrasalVerbs.ko: 중요한 일을 하지 않고, 장난치거나 허비하는 행동을 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be sad and wander around because you are missing someone or something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 그리워서 슬퍼하며 방황하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to clean liquid or a mess from a surface using a mop, cloth, or something similar
phrasalVerbs.ko: 걸레, 대걸레 등으로 표면에 있는 액체나 오염을 닦아내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move around slowly and sadly, often because you are upset or unhappy about something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가에 속상하거나 불행해서 천천히 슬프게 돌아다니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to speak in a rude, disrespectful, or loud way, often complaining or saying what you think when you shouldn’t.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무례하고, 불손하게, 또는 시끄럽게 말하다. 자주 불평하거나, 말하지 말아야 할 때 자신의 생각을 말하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to change your location frequently, especially by going from one place to another
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 한 장소에서 다른 장소로 자주 이동하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start living in a new house, apartment, or place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 새 집, 아파트, 장소에서 살기 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to approach someone or something closely, often in order to take control, get involved, or take action.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가에 가까이 다가가서 통제하거나 개입하거나 행동하려는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop focusing on something from the past and continue with your life or next activity
phrasalVerbs.ko: 과거의 일에 집착하지 않고 자신의 인생이나 다음 활동을 계속하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To change your position or move something to the side so there is space for someone or something else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 위해 자신의 위치를 바꾸거나 무언가를 옆으로 옮기는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to change the position of someone or something to a higher place or a higher level, or to advance forward
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가의 위치를 더 높은 곳이나 더 높은 수준으로 옮기거나 앞으로 나아가게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to hit, knock over, or kill someone or something, usually by using a vehicle or weapon
phrasalVerbs.ko: 차량이나 무기를 사용하여 사람이나 사물을 치거나 넘어뜨리거나 죽이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend time doing things that are not important, often just for fun or without any clear purpose. Similar to: 'muck around'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 중요하지 않은 일을 하며 시간을 보내다. 대개 재미로 하거나 뚜렷한 목적 없이. 'muck around'와 비슷함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to do something badly or make a mistake that ruins a situation or task.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 일을 잘못하거나 실수해서 상황이나 과제를 망치다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to think about something carefully for a period of time before making a decision
phrasalVerbs.ko: 결정을 내리기 전에 어떤 것을 신중하게 오랫동안 생각하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To push your way into a place, activity, or situation, especially when you are not welcome or without being invited.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 환영받지 않거나 초대받지 않았는데도 억지로 장소나 활동, 상황에 들어가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gather or find a quality, feeling, or strength inside yourself, especially when it is difficult
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 힘들 때 자신 안에서 어떤 자질, 감정, 힘 등을 모으거나 찾아내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something certain or definite, usually by deciding on final details.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 최종 세부 사항을 정해 어떤 것을 확실하게 하거나 확정하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to reduce the number of options or possibilities, making something more specific or easier to choose.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 선택지나 가능성을 줄여서 더 구체적이거나 선택하기 쉽도록 하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly remove or cut a small piece from something, usually by pinching or snipping.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가에서 작은 조각을 빠르게 떼어내거나 자르는 것, 보통 손가락이나 가위로.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fall asleep, especially when you are sitting down, often without meaning to
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 앉아 있을 때, 원하지 않았는데도 깜빡 졸다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To discover or find something, especially something hidden or secret, by searching carefully.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 숨겨져 있거나 비밀인 것을 꼼꼼히 찾아내거나 발견하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to present or give something, often in a formal or respectful way, especially as a sign of thanks, worship, or respect.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 감사, 예배, 존경의 표시로 어떤 것을 공식적이거나 정중하게 바치다 또는 드리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To slowly come out of someone or something in a thick or sticky way, like a liquid.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 액체처럼 걸쭉하거나 끈적한 형태로 누군가 또는 무언가에서 천천히 흘러나오다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To start something so people can use it or to begin operation of a place, such as a shop or office.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 기회, 일자리, 옵션 등이 이용 가능해지는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to perform a medical surgery on someone or something; to use skills, usually medical, to fix something inside a person, animal, or device
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가에게 의학적 수술을 시행하다; 보통 의학적 기술을 사용하여 사람, 동물 또는 기기의 내부를 고치다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to decide not to take part in something or not to be included in it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 일에 참여하지 않거나 포함되지 않기로 결정하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To start or begin in a particular place, situation, or thing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 장소, 상황 또는 사물에서 시작하거나 기원하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To gain weight quickly or in a short period of time, especially from eating a lot.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 많이 먹어서 짧은 기간에 체중이 빠르게 늘다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To join with another person to make a group of two, often for an activity or event.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 활동이나 이벤트를 위해 다른 사람과 짝을 이루다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become friends with someone or start spending time together as friends
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가와 친구가 되거나 친구처럼 함께 시간을 보내기 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To trick someone into accepting something unwanted or not valuable.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 원하지 않거나 가치 없는 것을 남에게 속여서 넘기다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: If something pans out, it means it turns out well or is successful, especially after some effort or waiting.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 '잘 풀리다'란 노력을 하거나 기다린 끝에 일이 잘 되거나 성공적으로 끝난다는 의미입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to reduce something by removing unnecessary parts, making it smaller or simpler
phrasalVerbs.ko: 불필요한 부분을 제거하여 더 작거나 단순하게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give something away or to let something go, even if you don't really want to
phrasalVerbs.ko: 정말로 원하지 않아도 무언가를 내어주거나 놓아주다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to separate part of a space or area from the rest by putting up a wall or dividers
phrasalVerbs.ko: 벽이나 칸막이를 세워 공간의 일부를 나누거나 분리하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to join with another person to form a pair, especially for an activity or event
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 활동이나 행사에서 다른 사람과 짝을 이루다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To give something to each person in a group so everyone can have or see it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 모두가 가질 수 있거나 볼 수 있도록 그룹의 각 사람에게 무엇인가를 돌리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: A polite or gentle way to say that someone has died.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 사망했다는 것을 공손하거나 부드럽게 표현하는 방법.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To pretend that someone or something is something else, usually to trick others.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 다른 것으로 가장하여 보통 다른 사람을 속이려는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give something, such as information, a message, or an object, to someone else so they can have it or know it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 정보, 메시지, 물건 등을 다른 사람에게 주어 그 사람이 갖거나 알 수 있게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to choose not to accept or take part in something; to decline an offer, invitation, or opportunity.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇을 받아들이거나 참여하지 않기로 선택하다; 제안, 초대, 기회를 거절하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to suddenly become unconscious and fall down, usually because of heat, lack of air, or feeling unwell
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 더위, 산소 부족, 몸이 좋지 않아서 갑자기 의식을 잃고 쓰러지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to choose not to accept an opportunity, gift, or offer
phrasalVerbs.ko: 기회나 선물, 제안을 받아들이지 않기로 선택하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To fix a relationship or a problem after a disagreement or argument.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다툼이나 논쟁 후 관계나 문제를 수습하거나 바로잡다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give someone all the money you owe them, often when they finish working for you
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 결실을 맺는다는 것은 당신의 노력, 투자, 또는 일이 좋은 결과나 보상을 가져온다는 뜻입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give a large amount of money to someone or for something, usually as a payment, prize, or compensation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 대개 지급, 상금, 보상으로 누군가에게 큰 금액을 주다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give someone the full amount of money you owe, especially if you don't want to or it is difficult.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 원하지 않거나 어렵더라도 빚진 돈을 모두 갚다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To eat only a small amount of food, usually without interest or enjoyment, like a bird does.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 새처럼 관심이나 즐거움 없이 음식의 아주 적은 양만 먹는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take the outer layer or covering off something, such as clothes or the skin of a fruit or vegetable.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷이나 과일 또는 채소의 껍질 등 무엇의 겉면이나 덮개를 벗기다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To fix or secure something to the ground using pegs, like making sure a tent or cover stays in place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 세부사항이나 합의를 확정하여 어떤 것을 확실하고, 명확하고, 분명하게 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move very quickly, especially by running or driving fast.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 뛰거나 빨리 운전하면서 매우 빠르게 움직이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone feel more lively, energetic, or cheerful; or to become more active and alert
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 더 활기차고, 에너지가 넘치고, 명랑하게 만들다; 또는 더 활발하고 민첩해지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to keep doing something, especially when it is difficult or when others want you to stop
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어렵거나 다른 사람들이 그만두길 원할 때에도 계속 무언가를 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to slowly start using or introducing something new in stages instead of all at once
phrasalVerbs.ko: 새로운 것을 한 번에가 아니라 여러 단계에 걸쳐 천천히 사용하거나 도입하기 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gradually stop using or providing something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇을 점진적으로 사용하지 않거나 제공하지 않게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To criticize someone or something repeatedly, often about small or unimportant things.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 대개 흥미나 식욕 없이 음식을 조금만 먹는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to choose or recognize something from a group of things or people
phrasalVerbs.ko: 여러 물건이나 사람들 중에서 어떤 것을 고르거나 알아보다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to buy something casually or without much planning, usually while doing something else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 누군가가 슬프거나 피곤할 때 더 기분이 좋아지거나 행복해지게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to eat much more food than you need, especially in a greedy way
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 탐욕스럽게 필요한 것보다 훨씬 많이 먹다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To increase in quantity or amount, usually in a way that makes something hard to manage.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 양이 늘어나서 관리하기 힘들어지는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone or something stay in one place or to make someone give a clear answer or decision
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 한 곳에 머물게 하거나, 누군가로부터 명확한 답변이나 결정을 얻어내는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To fasten something to a wall or board using a pin, thumbtack, or similar object.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 핀이나 압정으로 무언가를 벽이나 보드에 붙이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To become very sad and weak because you miss someone or something a lot for a long time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 오랫동안 많이 그리워해서 매우 슬프고 약해지는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop making noise or talking; to be quiet.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 소리내거나 말하는 것을 멈추다; 조용히 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to suddenly start talking, especially when you were silent before or when everyone else is quiet
phrasalVerbs.ko: 전에는 조용히 있다가 갑자기 말하기 시작하다, 또는 모두가 조용할 때 갑자기 말하기 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to help out or join in with others to do a task, especially by contributing effort or assistance.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 노력이나 도움을 제공하여 다른 사람들과 함께 일을 돕거나 참여하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gently put something onto a surface.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 조심스럽게 표면에 내려놓다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cover something, such as a hole or crack in a wall, with plaster to make it smooth and hidden
phrasalVerbs.ko: 벽의 구멍이나 균열 등을 석고로 덮어 매끄럽고 보이지 않게 만드는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to pretend to agree or cooperate with someone, usually to avoid problems or to make things easier
phrasalVerbs.ko: 문제를 피하거나 일을 쉽게 하기 위해 누군가에게 동의하는 척하거나 협조하는 척하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to act in a silly or playful way and not be serious
phrasalVerbs.ko: 장난치거나 진지하지 않게 행동하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something seem less important, serious, or bad than it really is.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것을 실제보다 덜 중요하거나 심각하거나 나쁘게 보이도록 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make two or more people or groups compete against each other, usually to gain an advantage for yourself.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 자신의 이익을 위해 두 명 이상의 사람이나 집단을 서로 경쟁하게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to emphasize or make something or someone seem more important, impressive, or better than they really are.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇이나 누구를 실제보다 더 중요하거나 인상적이거나 뛰어나게 보이도록 강조하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gently pull or tug repeatedly at something, often because you are nervous, bored, or distracted.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 긴장하거나, 지루하거나, 산만해서 무언가를 부드럽게 혹은 반복적으로 잡아당기다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something, like a pillow or cushion, look fuller or softer by shaking or patting it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 베개나 쿠션 등을 두드리거나 흔들어서 더 푹신하게 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to show or mention something or someone so that others notice or understand it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람들이 알거나 이해할 수 있도록 무언가나 누군가를 보여주거나 언급하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to look for something in a place by searching through things in a casual or curious way
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것을 찾기 위해 장소를 이리저리 뒤지거나 호기심으로 살펴보다

phrasalVerbs.definition: If something pokes out, it sticks out or comes out a little from behind or inside something else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것이 튀어나오면, 그것은 다른 것에서 약간 밖으로 나오거나 드러나 보입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To finish something quickly and completely, especially food or tasks.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 음식이나 과제를 빠르고 완전히 끝내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something better, cleaner, or more skillful through practice or effort
phrasalVerbs.ko: 연습이나 노력으로 무언가를 더 잘하거나, 깨끗하게 하거나, 능숙하게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly visit a place for a short time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어딘가에 잠깐 들르다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a place for a short time, usually to do something quickly and then come back
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어딘가를 잠깐 다녀오다, 보통 빨리 어떤 일을 하고 다시 돌아오다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to appear or happen suddenly, often when you do not expect it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 예상치 못할 때 갑자기 나타나거나 발생하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to divide something into parts and give each person an equal share
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 나누어 각 사람에게 똑같은 몫을 주다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend time in a relaxed way, doing small and unimportant things, usually without any real purpose
phrasalVerbs.ko: 진짜 목적 없이, 작은 일들을 하면서 느긋하게 시간을 보내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to express your true feelings or thoughts in a very open and emotional way, especially by talking to someone you trust
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가에서 많은 양이나 숫자가 빠르게 쏟아져 나오다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get ready for something that will happen, or to help someone get ready for something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 곧 일어날 일에 대비하거나, 누군가가 그것에 대비하도록 돕는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to push something or someone downward, usually using your hand or another object.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손이나 다른 물건으로 무엇이나 누군가를 아래로 누르다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to keep going with something, especially when it is difficult or after a pause.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어렵거나 잠시 멈춘 후에도 계속하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To use force or pressure to remove something from an object, usually by squeezing or flattening.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 짜거나 눌러서 물건에서 무언가를 힘이나 압력으로 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move forward and reach a later or more advanced stage of something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 앞으로 나아가서 더 늦거나 더 발전된 단계에 도달하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To support something by putting something under or behind it to keep it from falling down.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 넘어지지 않도록 아래나 뒤에 무언가를 대어 받쳐 주다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give someone something that they need or want
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 필요한 것 또는 원하는 것을 주다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To swell, expand, or make something bigger by filling it with air or by tensing the muscles.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 공기를 넣거나 근육을 긴장시켜 부풀다, 또는 무언가를 더 크게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To talk about someone or yourself in a way that makes them or you seem more important or impressive.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신이나 다른 사람을 더 중요하거나 인상적으로 보이게 말하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move farther from someone or something, either physically or emotionally.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 또는 무엇에서 물리적 또는 감정적으로 멀어지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to destroy a building or structure, usually so that something else can be built in its place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 불행하거나 슬프거나 기운이 빠지게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to attract a lot of people, attention, or money.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 많은 사람들, 관심 또는 돈을 끌어들이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to succeed in doing something difficult or unexpected
phrasalVerbs.ko: 잡아당겨서 떼어내다, 끌어당겨 제거하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to withdraw or remove people or things from a place, especially in an official or organized way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 공식적이거나 조직적인 방법으로 사람이나 물건을 장소에서 철수시키거나 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move your vehicle to the side of the road and stop, usually for a short time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 차를 길가에 세우고 잠시 정차하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start feeling better after being sick or having a difficult time. Similar to 'recover' or 'get better'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아프거나 힘든 시간을 보낸 후에 다시 좋아지기 시작하다. '회복하다'와 비슷한 의미.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get better after a serious illness or difficult situation; to survive or recover successfully.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 심각한 병이나 어려운 상황을 극복하고 회복하다; 무사히 살아남다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to tell someone that they have done something wrong or to criticize them for their behavior
phrasalVerbs.ko: 차를 어떤 장소로 몰고 가서 그곳에 세우다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To record the time you arrive at work, usually by using a time clock or a special machine. This is often done in workplaces to keep track of employees' working hours. Synonym: 'clock in'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 출근 시간을 기록하다. 보통 근태 기록기나 특수 기계를 사용하여 직원의 근무 시간을 관리할 때 사용한다. 동의어: '출근 체크하다'.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To officially record the end of your working hours by using a time clock at your workplace.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 직장에서 근무시간 종료를 근태기 등으로 공식적으로 기록하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To treat someone in a rude or bossy way, telling them what to do without respect.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 무례하거나 거만하게 대하며 존중 없이 명령하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move someone or something away from yourself by using your hands or body. It can also mean to avoid people emotionally or stop them from getting close to you.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손이나 몸을 이용해 누군가 또는 무언가를 자신으로부터 멀리 밀어내는 것. 또한 감정적으로 사람들을 회피하거나 가까워지지 못하게 하는 것을 의미할 수 있음.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to press or move someone or something to a lower position, usually using your hand or another part of your body.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손이나 신체의 다른 부분을 사용하여 누군가 또는 무언가를 더 낮은 위치로 누르거나 움직이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to continue moving forward or to make someone or something continue moving forward, especially when it is difficult
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어려울 때 계속 앞으로 나아가거나 누구 또는 무엇을 계속 앞으로 나아가게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone or something leave a place or position, often by using force or pressure.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 힘이나 압력으로 장소나 지위에서 떠나게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To succeed in making something happen or to move forward despite difficulties or obstacles.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어려움이나 장애에도 불구하고 무언가를 이루거나 앞으로 나아가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move something or someone to a higher position by using force from below
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아래에서 힘을 주어 무언가나 누군가를 더 높은 위치로 옮기다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to explain an idea, opinion, or message so that people understand it clearly
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아이디어, 의견 또는 메시지를 사람들이 명확하게 이해할 수 있도록 설명하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To eat a large amount of food, especially quickly or easily.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 제자리나 적절한 곳에 두어 정리되고 치워지게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to write something on a list or record it in writing
phrasalVerbs.ko: 상처주는 말을 하거나, 비판하거나 모욕해서 누군가를 덜 중요하게 느끼게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to submit something such as an application, request, or order formally
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 설치하거나 추가하여 사용할 준비가 되도록 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to delay doing something or decide to do it at a later time
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 누군가 또는 무언가를 싫어하거나 흥미를 잃게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to trick or tease someone by making them believe something that is not true
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷이나 액세서리를 착용하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move something away from your body so that it is extended in front of you or to the side.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 대중이 볼 수 있도록 출판하거나 출시하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to connect someone to another person on the phone
phrasalVerbs.ko: 전화를 통해 누군가를 다른 사람에게 연결해 주다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give someone medicine (anesthesia) to make them sleep or unconscious, usually before surgery or a medical procedure
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 잠들거나 의식을 잃게 하기 위해 약(마취제)을 투여하다. 보통 수술이나 의료 시술 전에 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to let someone stay at your home for a short time, usually as a guest
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇의 가격이나 비용을 올리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to accept or deal with someone or something unpleasant without complaining
phrasalVerbs.ko: 불쾌한 사람이나 일을 불평하지 않고 받아들이거나 참다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to find the answer to something that is confusing or difficult to understand.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 혼란스럽거나 이해하기 어려운 것의 답을 찾다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend time thinking carefully about something because it is difficult to understand or solve
phrasalVerbs.ko: 이해하거나 해결하기 어려워서 어떤 것에 대해 신중하게 생각하는 데 시간을 들이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stand in a line and wait for your turn to get or do something. This phrase is mostly used in British English.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 얻거나 하려고 자신의 차례를 기다리며 줄을 서는 것. 이 표현은 주로 영국식 영어에서 사용됩니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone or something less noisy, or to become less noisy and calmer.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 덜 시끄럽게 만들거나, 더 조용해지고 차분해지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To collect or achieve a large number or amount of something over time, especially points, money, or achievements.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 점수, 돈, 성과 등을 시간에 걸쳐 많이 모으거나 달성하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To give something away as a prize in a lottery, usually to raise money for a cause.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 경품으로 내놓아 복권 등으로 추첨하여 배포하다(보통 자선 모금 목적으로 사용됨).

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put a fence, rail, or barrier around something to enclose or protect it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 둘러싸거나 보호하기 위해 울타리, 난간, 장벽 등을 설치하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fall or be sent in large amounts onto someone or something, as if it were rain.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 비처럼 대량으로 누군가 또는 무언가 위에 내리거나 쏟아지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To cancel or stop an outdoor event because it is raining.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 비 때문에 야외 행사를 취소하거나 중단하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to lift something or someone to a higher position
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇이나 누군가를 더 높은 위치로 들어올리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To earn or collect a large amount of money, often easily or quickly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 쉽거나 빠르게 많은 돈을 벌거나 모으다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take a part of money or profits for yourself, often in a secret or dishonest way
phrasalVerbs.ko: 돈이나 이익의 일부를 자신의 몫으로, 종종 비밀스럽거나 부정하게 챙기다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to mention, talk about, or draw attention to something unpleasant or embarrassing from the past that people may want to forget.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람들이 잊고 싶어하는 과거의 불쾌하거나 난처한 일을 언급하거나 주목하게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to force someone to accept or learn something, especially in a way that is too strong or aggressive
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 강한 힘이나 압력으로 아래로 밀어 넣거나 누르는 것, 빽빽하게 또는 단단하게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to talk for a long time in a disorganized or boring way, often without getting to the point, especially about someone or something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇에 대해 장황하고 산만하거나 지루하게, 요점 없이 오래 이야기하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To gradually increase the amount, speed, or strength of something, especially in business or production.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 비즈니스나 생산에서 어떤 것의 양, 속도 또는 강도를 점진적으로 늘리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To automatically focus on or aim at a specific target, especially by using technology or navigation systems.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 기술이나 내비게이션 시스템을 사용하여 특정 대상을 자동으로 초점 맞추거나 조준하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gradually reduce the level or amount of something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇의 수준이나 양을 점차 줄이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give people a limited or fixed amount of something, especially so it lasts longer or everyone gets a share.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람들에게 어떤 것을 더 오래가게 하거나 모두가 나눠 갖게 하기 위해 제한된 양만 나누어 주다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To say or list something quickly, without pausing or stopping, usually from memory.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 멈추지 않고 보통 암기로 무언가를 빠르게 말하거나 나열하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep talking for a long time in a way that is boring or not important, especially about something or someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특별히 중요하지 않거나 지루한 방식으로 오랫동안 이야기하다, 특히 어떤 것 또는 사람에 대해서.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put your hand inside something, like a bag or a container, usually to get something out
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가(가방이나 용기 등) 안에 손을 넣어 보통 무언가를 꺼내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To contact someone, usually for help, support, or to offer help.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 연락하다. 보통 도움이나 지원을 요청하거나 제공하기 위해.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to say or list information, facts, or things quickly, usually from memory, and often without stopping or thinking much.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 정보나 사실 등을 빠르게 (보통 암기해서) 말하다, 생각하지 않고 쉼 없이 나열하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gradually let out something that is wound or rolled up, such as string, wire, or hose.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 실, 철사, 호스와 같이 감겨 있던 것을 점차 풀어내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: Used to introduce a topic or refer to something specific. It means 'about' or 'concerning' something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 주제를 소개하거나 무언가를 언급할 때 사용됩니다. '~에 관하여' 또는 '~에 대해'라는 의미입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To control or limit someone or something; to stop them from becoming too extreme or out of control.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 통제하거나 제한하다; 너무 극단적이거나 통제불능이 되는 것을 막다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to depend on someone or something because you trust them or believe they will help or support you.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 도와주거나 지원해줄 것이라고 믿고 의지하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to not do what you promised or agreed to do; to break a promise or agreement
phrasalVerbs.ko: 약속이나 합의를 지키지 않다; 약속이나 합의를 어기다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to let someone use your property or something you own for a period of time in exchange for money
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 자신의 재산이나 소유물을 일정 기간 돈을 받고 빌려주다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to depend or be based on something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇에 의존하거나 기반하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something go faster, become more active, or become more exciting.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 더 빠르게 하거나, 더 활발하게 하거나, 더 흥미롭게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to have someone or something as the main or most important focus or purpose; to be centered on something or someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 주요 초점 또는 목적(중심)으로 삼다; ~을 중심으로 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remove or get free from someone or something you don't want.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 원하지 않는 사람이나 것을 제거하거나 벗어나다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To leave a place by traveling on something like a bicycle, horse, or motorbike.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자전거, 말, 오토바이 등 무언가를 타고 자리를 떠나다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stay strong and get through a difficult or unpleasant situation until it ends.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 힘들고 불쾌한 상황이 끝날 때까지 강하게 버티다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to quickly put together or build something using whatever materials are available, usually for a short-term use.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손에 있는 재료로 급히 무언가를 조립하거나 만들어내다. 보통 임시로 사용하기 위해서이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: Used to show strong agreement with someone or to say that what they said is exactly right.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 강한 동의를 보이거나 그 말이 정확하다는 것을 표현할 때 사용합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a loud, clear sound that can be easily heard, especially suddenly or in a quiet place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 조용한 장소나 갑자기, 쉽게 들릴 수 있는 크고 또렷한 소리를 내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to enter the price of goods and record a sale on a cash register, usually in a store
phrasalVerbs.ko: 가게에서 계산기(포스기)에 상품의 가격을 입력하고 판매를 기록하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly wash someone or something with clean water to remove soap, dirt, or another substance.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 비누, 먼지 또는 다른 물질을 제거하기 위해 누군가나 무언가를 깨끗한 물로 빠르게 씻어내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to charge someone too much money or cheat them, especially by selling something at a very high price
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 너무 비싼 값을 청구하거나, 특히 물건을 매우 비싼 가격에 팔아 속이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To tear something into small pieces, usually with your hands.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 손으로 작은 조각으로 찢다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fight back or take action against people in power, usually to protest or change something unfair
phrasalVerbs.ko: 권력자들에 맞서 싸우거나 부당한 것을 바꾸기 위해 행동에 나서다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a place very quickly and noisily, usually in a vehicle.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 차량으로, 매우 빠르고 시끄럽게 장소를 떠나다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To arrive in large numbers or amounts, often continuously or unexpectedly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 많이, 자주 계속적이거나 예상치 못하게 도착하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To say or repeat something quickly and easily from memory, often without much effort.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 기억에서 빠르고 쉽게, 종종 아무런 노력 없이 말하거나 반복하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something flat by unrolling it, or to make something available for the first time, like a product or service.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 펼쳐서 평평하게 만들거나, 신제품이나 서비스를 처음으로 출시하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to delay or move a payment, contract, or debt to a later date.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 지불, 계약 또는 부채를 나중 날짜로 연기하거나 미루다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To fold or turn something over and over to make it into the shape of a tube or bundle.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 여러 번 접거나 말아서 관이나 다발 모양으로 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To persuade or trick someone into taking part in something, especially when they didn't really want to.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 설득하거나 속여서 어떤 일에 참여하게 하다, 특히 그 사람이 원하지 않았을 때.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to close or block an area using a rope, so that people cannot enter it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람들이 들어가지 못하게 밧줄로 구역을 막거나 차단하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to hurt someone by hitting or using violence, often to scare or threaten them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 때리거나 폭력을 사용하여 해치다. 주로 겁주거나 위협하기 위해 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make a number or amount lower by changing it to the nearest whole number less than or equal to it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 숫자나 금액을 그 값 이하의 가장 가까운 정수로 낮추는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To change a number to the nearest whole number, often to make it simpler or easier to use.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 만족스럽거나 적합한 방식으로 무언가를 마무리하다; 아름답게 완성하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something complete or finished by adding one last thing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 마지막으로 무언가를 추가하여 완성하거나 마무리하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gather people or things together in one place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 물건을 한 곳에 모으다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to force someone or something to leave a place, usually by searching for them or making them go out
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 찾아내거나 내보내어 억지로 그 장소에서 떠나도록 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gently massage or clean something by rubbing it, usually to help someone relax or to clean the surface of something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 편안하게 해주거나 표면을 깨끗이 하기 위해, 부드럽게 문질러 마사지하거나 닦는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove something from a surface by rubbing it with your hand or a cloth.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손이나 천으로 문질러 표면에서 무언가를 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remove marks, writing, or drawings from a surface by rubbing it with your hand, an eraser, or something similar.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손, 지우개 또는 비슷한 것으로 표면의 자국, 글씨 또는 그림을 문질러서 지우다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To decide that something is not possible or not suitable, or to reject an option or person from consideration.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가가 가능하지 않거나 적합하지 않다고 판단하거나, 고려 대상에서 옵션이나 사람을 제외하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to find or meet someone or something by chance.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 우연히 만나거나 발견하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be very busy, moving from one place to another to do many tasks
phrasalVerbs.ko: 많은 일을 하려고 여기저기 바쁘게 돌아다니다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a place or person suddenly, especially to escape from a difficult or dangerous situation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어려운 상황이나 위험한 상황에서 벗어나기 위해 장소나 사람을 갑자기 떠나다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to use something until there is nothing left or until it stops working
phrasalVerbs.ko: 너무 많이 일하거나 자기관리를 하지 않아 매우 피곤하고, 약하거나 기력이 없는 상태를 나타냄.

phrasalVerbs.definition: If a performance, event, or show runs for a certain period, it means it is available or continues happening for that amount of time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 공연, 행사, 쇼가 일정 기간 동안 진행된다는 것은 그 기간 동안 이용 가능하거나 계속된다는 것을 의미합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to reach or experience a large amount of something, usually a problem or a high cost
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 문제나 많은 비용 등, 큰 양의 어떤 것에 도달하거나 경험하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to flow or drain away from a surface, especially liquids like water.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 쫓아서 그 장소를 떠나게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep talking for a long time, usually in a boring or annoying way, especially without stopping or getting to the point.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 예상보다 더 오래 계속되거나 멈추지 않고 지속되다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish all of something so that none is left.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 모두 써서 남는 것이 없게 되다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 너무 많아서 무언가의 가장자리 밖으로 넘치거나 흘러나오는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to use up or spend something, such as money or resources, very quickly
phrasalVerbs.ko: 돈이나 자원 등을 매우 빠르게 다 써버리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cause a debt, bill, or cost to increase quickly, usually by spending a lot of money (especially on credit or bills)
phrasalVerbs.ko: 빚, 청구서, 비용 등을 (주로 신용카드나 청구서로) 빠르게 늘리다, 많은 돈을 써서 늘리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move quickly from one place to another because you are in a hurry.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 서두르기 때문에 한 장소에서 다른 장소로 빠르게 이동하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To complete something, like a test or process, very easily and successfully, with little difficulty.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 시험이나 과정과 같은 일을 매우 쉽게, 성공적으로, 거의 어려움 없이 끝내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to keep money over time so you can buy something in the future
phrasalVerbs.ko: 미래에 무언가를 사기 위해 돈을 모으다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To reduce the size, amount, or extent of something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가의 크기, 양, 범위를 줄이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something bigger or increase it in size, amount, or importance, especially in a planned way
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 계획적으로 무언가를 더 크거나, 양이나 중요성을 증가시키는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone or something go away by making them feel afraid.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 겁을 주어 쫓아내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove something from inside a container or place using a spoon or similar tool.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 숟가락이나 비슷한 도구로 용기나 장소 안에서 무언가를 꺼내는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly pick up or gather something, usually with your hands or a tool.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 손이나 도구로 재빠르게 집거나 모으다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to manage to get by or survive with just enough, often with difficulty; to have barely enough money, resources, or success to get through a situation
phrasalVerbs.ko: 간신히 넘기다, 겨우겨우 살아가다; 돈이나 자원이 부족한 상황에서 가까스로 버티거나 살아남다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove something, like a word or name, by drawing a line through it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 단어나 이름 등을 줄을 그어 지우다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To separate someone or something from an area by using a screen or a divider, so they are hidden or blocked from view.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 스크린이나 칸막이로 구분해서 보이지 않게 하거나 차단하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make a mistake or do something badly, causing a problem or failure.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 실수하거나 일을 망쳐서 문제나 실패를 일으키는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to squeeze or crush something into a smaller, often wrinkled or messy shape
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 작은 주름지거나 지저분한 모양으로 압착하거나 구기다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to block or close an area or object so that nothing can enter or leave
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아무것도 들어오거나 나가지 못하도록 구역이나 물체를 봉쇄하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to realize that someone is lying or not being sincere
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어려운 시기에 문제를 해결할 때까지 돈이나 격려 등으로 누군가를 도와주거나 지지하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to look carefully for someone or something, especially when it is hard to find.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 찾기 어려운 사람이나 것을 신중하게 찾다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly sell something, usually at a low price, because it is no longer needed or you want to get rid of it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 더 이상 필요 없거나 처분하려고 보통 낮은 가격에 무언가를 빨리 파는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To sell all of something so that there is none left.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 배신하거나, 보통 돈이나 승인과 같은 개인적 이득을 위해 자신의 가치를 포기하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to sell all your possessions, property, or business, often because you are moving or starting a new life elsewhere.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신의 모든 소유물이나 재산, 사업을 모두 파는 것, 보통 이사를 가거나 새로운 삶을 시작할 때 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to share something with a group of people, usually by physically giving it to each person or by sending it to each member of a group
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 그룹 사람들과 공유하다. 보통 각자에게 직접 전달하거나 각 구성원에게 보내는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to ask someone to come to help or do something, usually by sending a message or making a request
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 메시지나 요청을 보내어 누군가를 오도록 하거나, 무언가를 가져오게 요청하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to submit something, like a form, assignment, or application, by post or online for someone to review or process
phrasalVerbs.ko: 양식, 과제, 신청서 등을 우편이나 온라인으로 제출하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to forward something, like a message, letter, or parcel, to another person or place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 메시지, 편지, 소포 등을 다른 사람이나 장소로 전달(전송)하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give or deliver something, like messages, invitations, or information, to many people at once.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 메시지, 초대장 또는 정보를 여러 사람에게 한 번에 전달하거나 발송하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to attack someone physically or verbally
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 시작하다, 특히 노력이나 계획이 필요한 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To write something, usually to record information or ideas so you don’t forget them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 들고 있던 것을 표면에 내려놓다; 조심스럽게 내려두다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start a journey or leave for a place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 갑자기 어떤 일이 일어나거나 시작되도록 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to arrange or display things in an organized way, often so they can be seen or used easily
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물건을 보기 쉽고 사용하기 쉽도록 정리해서 배열하거나 배치하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to arrange, organize, or prepare something, such as an event, a piece of equipment, or a business
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 속여서 죄를 뒤집어씌우다, 특히 그 사람이 하지도 않은 일로 곤란하게 만들거나 비난받게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To become calm and quiet, or to help someone or something become calm and quiet.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 차분하고 조용해지거나, 누군가나 무언가를 차분하고 조용하게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To finally choose or decide on something after considering different options.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 여러 가지 선택지를 고려한 후 결국 어떤 것을 선택하거나 결정하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to live together with someone as a couple, usually without being married
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 결혼하지 않고 커플로서 함께 살다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get rid of someone or something that is bothering you or holding you back.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 귀찮거나 방해가 되는 사람이나 것을 떨쳐내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move something quickly up and down or side to side so that the contents mix together well
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 갑자기 놀라게 하거나 충격을 주어 당황하게, 걱정하게, 불안하게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to improve or develop in a good way; to progress well.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 좋은 방향으로 개선되거나 발전하다; 잘 진행되다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To do something very well or be very good at a particular activity.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 매우 잘 하거나 특정 활동에서 매우 뛰어나다는 의미입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To fire a weapon at something, like an aircraft, so that it falls to the ground; often used when talking about military situations.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무기 등으로 비행기 같은 것을 쏴서 떨어뜨리다; 주로 군사 상황에서 사용함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To try to achieve or reach a specific goal or result.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 목표나 결과를 이루려고 노력하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to rise or increase very quickly in a short time
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아주 짧은 시간에 매우 빠르게 오르다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to push your way into a place or group using your shoulders, usually to get past people or into a crowded area
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어깨로 밀치며 사람들 사이로 밀고 들어가다(보통 붐비는 곳이나 군중 속으로)

phrasalVerbs.definition: to say something loudly, often so everyone can hear
phrasalVerbs.ko: 모두가 들을 수 있도록 무언가를 크게 말하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly put a lot of something, especially food, into your mouth or another place without much care.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 음식을 빠르게, 신경 쓰지 않고 입이나 다른 곳에 많이 집어넣다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to try to get people's attention by displaying something or by behaving in a way that makes others notice you, usually because you are proud of it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 자랑하거나, 사람들의 관심을 끌기 위해 일부러 행동하는 것 (보통 자랑스러워서).

phrasalVerbs.definition: to arrive at a place where you are expected, especially for an event, appointment, or meeting.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 숨겨져 있거나 잘 보이지 않던 것이 보이거나 눈에 띄게 되다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to avoid doing something because it is unpleasant or difficult, often by hesitating or pulling back.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 불쾌하거나 어려운 일을 피하기 위해 망설이거나 물러서는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To become dry, smaller, and wrinkled, usually because of losing water.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물기를 잃어 말라서 작아지고 주름지는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To ignore something or someone because you think it or they are not important.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 중요하지 않다고 생각하여 무엇이나 누구를 무시하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep someone in a place where they cannot leave, often for a long time, usually because of punishment or to protect them or others.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 벌이나 보호를 위해 오랫동안 밖으로 나갈 수 없는 곳에 가두다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to turn something off or stop it from working, usually a machine, computer, or business.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 기계, 컴퓨터, 사업체 등을 끄거나 중지시키는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to keep someone or something inside a place and not let them leave, usually by closing a door or barrier.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 안에 두고 나가지 못하게 하다. 보통 문이나 장애물을 닫아서 막는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to turn something off so it stops working or flowing, like water, electricity, or a machine.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 다른 사람들과의 연결이나 접촉에서 차단하거나 고립시키다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To not let someone or something be involved or enter a place, group, or activity.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가가 어떤 장소, 그룹, 활동에 참여하거나 들어오지 못하게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop talking or to make someone or something stop talking or making noise.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 말을 멈추거나 누군가 또는 무언가가 말하거나 소리 내는 것을 멈추게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to avoid someone or something, especially because you feel nervous, unsure, or not confident.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 긴장하거나 자신이 없어서 누군가나 무언가를 피하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to approach someone quietly or slowly, often so that you are not noticed right away
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 조용히 또는 천천히 다가가서 바로 눈에 띄지 않도록 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to give up your rights, property, or ownership of something by signing a legal document.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 법적 문서에 서명함으로써 권리, 재산, 소유권 등을 포기하다.
