phrasalVerbs.definition: to write your name or information to show you have arrived at a place, such as a hotel, office, or event. Synonym: 'check in'
phrasalVerbs.ko: 호텔, 사무실, 행사장 등 도착했음을 표시하기 위해 이름이나 정보를 작성하는 것. 동의어: '체크인하다'

phrasalVerbs.definition: to officially agree to become part of a team, group, or activity, usually by signing a form or contract.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 양식이나 계약서에 서명함으로써 공식적으로 팀, 그룹 또는 활동의 일원이 되기로 동의하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To officially give ownership or legal rights of something, like property or a business, to someone else by signing documents.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 문서에 서명하여 재산이나 사업과 같은 소유권이나 법적 권리를 공식적으로 다른 사람에게 넘기는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to officially put your name on a list to join or participate in something, such as a course, event, or membership.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 공식적으로 명단에 이름을 올려 수업, 행사 또는 멤버십과 같은 것에 참여하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to sing at the same time as music or with another person, usually matching the words and tune.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 음악이나 다른 사람과 동시에, 보통 가사와 멜로디에 맞춰 노래하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to choose one person or thing from a group for special attention, often in a way that is different from others
phrasalVerbs.ko: 그룹에서 한 사람이나 사물을 특별히 주목하여 선택하다. 종종 다른 사람들과는 다르게 함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: If an idea or information sinks in, it means you start to really understand or realize it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 생각이나 정보가 ‘이해되다’는 것은, 그것을 진짜로 이해하거나 깨닫기 시작한다는 뜻입니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To take something, usually liquid or money, away from one place or use, often in a secret or dishonest way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 액체나 돈을 한 곳이나 용도에서 빼내가는 것, 보통 비밀스럽거나 부정직한 방법으로 사용함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to watch something happen without trying to stop it; to not take action when you could help or change the situation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 일어나도 막으려 하지 않고, 도울 수 있음에도 아무런 행동을 취하지 않는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move from a standing position to a sitting position, usually on a chair or another surface
phrasalVerbs.ko: 일어서 있는 자세에서 앉는 자세로 이동하는 것, 보통 의자나 다른 표면에 앉는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to attend a meeting, class, or event as an observer or guest, not as a main participant
phrasalVerbs.ko: 회의, 수업, 행사 등에 주 참가자가 아닌 관찰자나 손님으로 참석하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To not take part in an activity or event, usually so you can rest or watch instead.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 쉬거나 지켜보기 위해 어떤 활동이나 행사에 참여하지 않다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move from lying down to a sitting position, or to straighten your back and sit with good posture
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누운 자세에서 앉는 자세로 움직이거나, 등을 곧게 펴고 바른 자세로 앉다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To carefully look at a person or situation in order to understand or judge them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 상황을 이해하거나 판단하기 위해 신중하게 관찰하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To avoid talking about or dealing with something in detail, usually because it's difficult or uncomfortable.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어렵거나 불편해서 어떤 내용을 자세하게 언급하지 않고 대충 넘어가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove something from the surface or top of a liquid, or to take a portion for yourself in a way that is not always honest.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 액체의 표면이나 윗부분에서 무언가를 제거하거나, 항상 정직하지 않은 방식으로 자기 몫을 챙기는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to quickly look through written information without reading every word, usually to get the general idea or find important points.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것의 표면을 거의 건드리지 않으면서 그 위나 표면을 빠르고 부드럽게 스치듯 움직이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To talk about or deal with something too quickly or not give it enough attention, often to avoid discussing it fully.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 너무 빠르게 이야기하거나 충분한 관심을 기울이지 않고 다루는 것. 보통 완전한 논의를 피하려고 할 때 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to pass by or ignore something or someone, especially when going through a list or a group of things; to not pay attention to or select something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 목록이나 그룹을 살펴볼 때 무언가나 누군가를 건너뛰거나 무시하다; 주의를 기울이지 않거나 선택하지 않다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put something on quickly and without much care, usually something like clothes, make-up, or cream
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷, 화장품, 크림 등을 빠르고 대충 바르거나 입다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stay in bed and wake up later than usual in the morning
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아침에 평소보다 늦게 일어나 침대에 더 오래 머무는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to sleep in order to feel better after having too much alcohol, food, or feeling very tired
phrasalVerbs.ko: 술, 음식 등을 과하게 먹거나 매우 피곤할 때 잠을 자서 회복하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to wait until the next day to think more carefully before making a decision
phrasalVerbs.ko: 더 신중하게 결정하기 위해 다음 날까지 기다리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To spend the night at someone else's house, usually as a guest.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 손님으로서 다른 사람의 집에서 하룻밤을 보내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cut something into thin pieces or slices, usually with a knife.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 얇은 조각이나 슬라이스로 자르다, 보통 칼로.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make hair smooth and flat, usually by using water or a styling product
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물을 묻히거나 스타일링 제품을 사용하여 머리카락을 매끈하고 평평하게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone or yourself look more neat, tidy, or stylish
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 자신을 더 단정하고 깔끔하며 멋지게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move smoothly down the surface of something, like a pole or a banister, usually by sitting or holding on and letting gravity take you down
phrasalVerbs.ko: 폴대나 난간과 같은 표면을 앉거나 잡고 중력에 몸을 맡겨 부드럽게 아래로 이동하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become thinner by losing weight, usually by eating healthier or exercising
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 더 건강하게 먹거나 운동하여 살이 빠져 날씬해지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to go by or disappear quickly, often without being noticed
phrasalVerbs.ko: 알지 못하는 사이에 빠르게 지나가거나 사라지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to quickly and smoothly put on or enter something, such as clothes or a place, often without much effort
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷이나 장소 등에 빠르고 부드럽게, 큰 노력 없이 입거나 들어가다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To leave a place quietly or secretly, so other people do not notice.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람들이 눈치채지 못하게 조용히 또는 몰래 자리를 뜨다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to quickly put on an item of clothing, usually without much effort or care
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷을 대충 또는 빠르게 입다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a small mistake, often by accident
phrasalVerbs.ko: 작은 실수를 하다, 종종 실수로

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move, do something, or become less active at a lower speed or pace; to make something slower.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 움직임이나 활동이 느려지거나 덜 활발해지다; 무엇인가를 느리게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to break something into pieces so it is badly damaged or destroyed, often violently.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 산산조각 내거나 심하게 부수거나 파괴하는 것, 종종 난폭하게.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To discover or find someone or something by using your sense of smell, often used about dogs or animals.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 냄새를 맡아서 사람이나 사물을 찾아내다. 주로 개나 동물에 대해 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a place have a strong, usually unpleasant smell.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 장소에 강하고 대개 불쾌한 냄새가 나게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To force someone or something to leave a hiding place, usually by using smoke or another method that makes it uncomfortable to stay.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 연기 등 불편한 수단을 사용해 누군가 또는 무언가를 은신처에서 나오도록 강요하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something flat, even, or free of wrinkles or lumps by pressing or spreading it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 누르거나 펼쳐서 평평하거나 주름, 혹이 없게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To try to make a problem, argument, or bad situation seem less serious or easier to accept.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 문제나 다툼, 나쁜 상황을 덜 심각하게 보이거나 더 받아들이기 쉽게 하려고 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to speak to someone suddenly and angrily, often because you are annoyed or stressed; can also mean to try to bite quickly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 갑자기 화가 난 듯 말하다. 짜증나거나 스트레스 받을 때 흔히 나타남. 또는 빠르게 물려고 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to quickly break a small, hard, or brittle part from something, usually with a sharp movement
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 빠른 동작으로, 무언가의 작고 단단하거나 부서지기 쉬운 부분을 똑 부러뜨리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to buy or take something quickly because it is in demand or a good deal.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 인기 있거나 좋은 거래라서 재빨리 사거나 차지하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly grab or take something, especially before someone else can get it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 누군가가 차지하기 전에 재빨리 무엇인가를 잡거나 가져가는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a place or a group quietly and secretly, so that other people don't notice.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람들이 알아차리지 못하게 조용하고 은밀하게 장소나 모임을 떠나다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To enter a place quietly and secretly, so that no one sees or hears you.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아무에게도 들키거나 보이지 않도록 조용히 비밀리에 장소에 들어가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To find or discover something or someone, especially by using your sense of smell or by being very attentive.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 후각을 사용하거나 매우 주의 깊게 하여 무언가나 누군가를 찾아내거나 발견하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cut something off by using scissors or a similar tool.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 가위나 비슷한 도구로 무언가를 잘라내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop a flame from burning, usually by putting something over it to remove the air.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 공기를 차단하기 위해 무언가를 덮어서 불꽃을 끄다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: When a liquid passes through something and makes it completely wet.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 액체가 무언가를 통과하여 완전히 젖게 만들 때.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To absorb something, like a liquid, experience, or information, either physically or in a figurative way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 액체나 경험, 정보 등을 물리적 또는 비유적으로 흡수하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become less drunk or help someone become less drunk, usually after drinking too much alcohol.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 술에 덜 취하게 되거나, 누군가가 덜 취하도록 도와주는 것. 보통 술을 많이 마신 후에 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to organize, fix, or solve a problem or situation
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 문제를 일으키면, 특히 그들과 대화를 하거나 훈육하여 처리하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to speak loudly and forcefully about your opinions, often complaining or criticizing something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신의 의견을 시끄럽고 강하게 말하다, 종종 불평하거나 비판하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To say each letter or part of a word slowly to help you read or understand it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇에 대해 어떻게 생각하거나 느끼는지 알기 위해 누군가에게 질문하다 (주로 결정을 내리기 전에)

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cause something to start suddenly, often a reaction, argument, or event
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 갑자기 일으키다. 종종 반응이나 논쟁, 사건 등을 가리킴

phrasalVerbs.definition: to express someone else's opinion or to represent someone or something by speaking on their behalf.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람의 의견을 표현하거나 누구 또는 무엇을 대신하여 말하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to express your opinions or concerns about someone or something clearly and with confidence, especially when others are afraid to do so
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람들이 더 잘 들을 수 있도록 더 크게 말하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone or something go faster or happen more quickly
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 더 빠르게 하거나 일이 더 빨리 일어나게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to explain something clearly and in detail, so it is easy to understand
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 명확하고 자세하게 설명하다, 쉽게 이해할 수 있도록

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something more exciting, lively, or interesting.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 더 신나고, 활기차고, 흥미롭게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move out of a place in large numbers, especially when the space is too small; to flow or come out all at once.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 공간이 너무 작을 때 한 장소에서 많은 수가 한꺼번에 나오거나, 한 번에 흘러나오는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To go beyond the limits of a space, place, or situation and enter another. When a space is too full, what is in it moves into the next area.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 공간, 장소 또는 상황의 한계를 넘어 다른 곳으로 넘쳐 흐르는 것. 공간이 너무 가득 차면 안의 것이 옆 공간으로 이동함.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to say something suddenly or angrily, often when you don't want to keep it inside any longer
phrasalVerbs.ko: 삼키고 싶지 않아서 입에서 무언가를 밀어내는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To play or move in water, making it go everywhere.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물에서 놀거나 움직이면서 물을 여기저기 튀기다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to separate people or things into different groups or parts; also to end a romantic relationship.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 사물을 다른 그룹이나 부분으로 나누다; 연인 관계를 끝내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move things or people so they cover a larger area, or to move apart from each other
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사물이나 사람을 더 넓은 공간에 펼치거나, 서로 떨어져 움직이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cover the surface of something with another substance or to distribute something across an area or period of time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 물질로 어떤 표면을 덮거나, 어떤 것을 일정한 구역이나 기간에 걸쳐 분산시키는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to appear or start to exist very quickly and suddenly, often unexpectedly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 매우 빠르고 갑자기, 종종 예상하지 못하게 나타나거나 존재하기 시작하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To pay what you owe or settle a bill or debt with someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 빚이나 요금 등을 누군가에게 정산하다, 갚다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to just barely succeed, survive, or manage with only the minimum necessary resources or effort
phrasalVerbs.ko: 최소한의 자원이나 노력으로 간신히 성공하거나 살아남거나 버티다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get something out of a container or place by pressing it tightly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 단단히 눌러 용기나 장소에서 무언가를 꺼내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to arrange things in a neat pile, one on top of another
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물건을 하나씩 차곡차곡 쌓다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to completely end or eliminate something, especially something bad, often using strong actions
phrasalVerbs.ko: 나쁜 것을 완전히 끝내거나 없애다, 특히 강력한 조치를 사용하여

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be ready and waiting for someone or something, especially in case you are needed or something is about to happen
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어려운 상황에서 누군가와 함께 있고 그들을 지지하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to accept or allow a particular type of behavior or situation, usually something you think is wrong or unpleasant
phrasalVerbs.ko: 단어, 글자 또는 기호가 무엇을 의미할 때, 그것은 그 대상을 나타내거나 줄임말임을 뜻합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take someone's place for a short time when they cannot do something themselves
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 스스로 할 수 없을 때 잠시 그 사람을 대신하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be very easy to see or notice because something is different or special
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가가 다르거나 특별해서 눈에 잘 띄다, 두드러지게 보이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone or something go from a sitting or lying position to a vertical or upright position
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 도전하거나 비판할 때 자신이나 신념을 옹호하다; 압력, 반대 또는 어려움에 굴복하지 않다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To look directly at someone or something for so long and so confidently that they feel they have to look away.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 자신감 있게 오래 쳐다봐서 결국 상대가 시선을 피하게 하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to begin doing something, especially something new, or to begin a journey or career.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 (특히 새로운 것을) 시작하거나 여정이나 경력을 시작하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something begin working, especially a machine, engine, or computer.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 기계, 엔진, 컴퓨터 등을 작동시키기 시작하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to hide or store something in a safe or secret place, especially for future use.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 미래를 위해서 특히 무언가를 안전하거나 비밀스러운 곳에 숨기거나 보관하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To avoid someone or something, or not go near a person or place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 피하거나 사람이나 장소에 가까이 가지 않는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to not go on, touch, or use something; to avoid being on a place or using something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것에 가지 않거나, 만지거나, 사용하지 않는 것; 어떤 장소에 있거나 무엇을 사용하는 것을 피하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to continue to be in a place or position after others have left or after you were expected to leave
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람들이 떠난 후나 떠나야 할 시기 후에도 그 장소나 위치에 계속 남아 있는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend the night at someone else's place instead of going home.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 집에 가지 않고 남의 집에서 하룻밤을 보내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to not go to sleep at your usual time; to remain awake longer than normal, especially at night
phrasalVerbs.ko: 평소보다 늦게까지 자지 않고 깨어 있는 것; 특히 밤에 평소보다 오래 깨어 있는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave an important job or official position, usually so someone else can take over
phrasalVerbs.ko: 중요한 일자리나 공식 직책에서 물러나 보통 다른 사람이 맡을 수 있도록 하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become involved in a situation, especially to help, solve a problem, or stop something bad from happening
phrasalVerbs.ko: 상황에 개입하다, 특히 도와주거나, 문제를 해결하거나, 나쁜 일이 발생하는 것을 막기 위해

phrasalVerbs.definition: to increase the speed, amount, or effort of something; to do something more quickly or with greater intensity.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 중요한 일이 필요할 때 더 많은 책임을 지거나 행동에 나서다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stay in a place and not leave, usually because you might be needed or something is expected to happen soon.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 필요할 수도 있거나 곧 무언가가 일어날 것 같아서, 한 장소에 머무르며 떠나지 않는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stay loyal and continue to support someone or something, especially in difficult times.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어려운 시기에 누군가 혹은 무언가에게 충실하며 계속해서 지지하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To continue dealing with an unpleasant or difficult situation until it is finished, instead of quitting.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아주 눈에 띄거나 무언가의 표면에서 튀어나오다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To continue doing something or to keep using the same thing, without changing it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 바꾸지 않고 계속해서 하거나 같은 것을 사용하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to support or defend someone or something, especially when they are being criticized or treated unfairly. Similar to 'stand up for'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 은행이나 가게와 같은 공공 장소에서 무기를 들고 누군가를 위협하여 훔치는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To continue doing, using, or supporting something, and not change it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 계속 하거나, 사용하거나, 지지하며 바꾸지 않는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make a place smell very bad, usually so much that people don't want to stay there.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 장소를 너무 고약하게 만들어 사람들이 머무르고 싶지 않게 하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To cause problems, strong emotions, or trouble, often by making people feel angry or excited.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람들을 화나게 하거나 흥분하게 만들어 문제, 강한 감정, 혹은 소란을 일으키다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fill or block a hole or opening so that nothing can pass through
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아무것도 통과하지 못하도록 구멍이나 틈을 채우거나 막다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fix a problem or make something clear and organized
phrasalVerbs.ko: 문제를 해결하거나 무언가를 명확하고 정리되게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make yourself or something stand or sit in a more upright, straight position
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신이나 무언가를 더 곧고 똑바로 된 자세로 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to extend or spread over a long area next to something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇을 따라 길게 뻗어 있다, 긴 구역에 걸쳐 펼쳐지다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something longer or to lie down with your body extended
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 더 길게 만들거나 몸을 쭉 펴고 눕다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To cause someone to become very ill or to die suddenly, often due to illness or an unexpected event.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 법, 규칙, 결정이 불법 또는 잘못되었다고 판단되어 공식적으로 종료되거나 폐지되는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To officially remove someone or something from a list, group, or record, often as a punishment or because they no longer qualify.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 벌이나 자격 상실로 인해 공식적으로 명단, 그룹, 기록에서 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to fail or not succeed, especially after trying to do something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 혼자서, 다른 사람의 도움 없이 독립적으로 무언가를 시작하다 (일, 생활, 어디론가 가는 것 등).

phrasalVerbs.definition: to begin something, such as a conversation, friendship, or music, often in a social situation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 대화, 우정, 음악 등 어떤 것을 시작하다. 주로 사회적 상황에서 쓰임.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To strongly criticize or scold someone, usually because they did something wrong.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 의학적 이유나 준비를 위해 모든 또는 대부분의 옷을 벗다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to sign up to regularly receive or pay for something, like a magazine, a service, or a channel
phrasalVerbs.ko: 정기적으로 잡지·서비스·채널 등을 받거나 이용하기 위해 가입하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get involved in an unpleasant or difficult situation, often without wanting to.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 빨아들이는 힘을 이용해 무언가를 입이나 몸 안으로 들이마시는 것(숨 쉬거나 마시는 것처럼).

phrasalVerbs.definition: To say or do nice things to someone, usually someone in authority, because you want them to like you or give you something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 진공청소기가 먼지나 액체를 빨아들이듯, 흡입력을 사용하여 무언가를 공간이나 용기 안으로 빨아들이는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To find the total amount by adding numbers or amounts together. Synonym: 'add up'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇에 대한 주요 내용이나 가장 중요한 정보를 간략히 말하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To lose weight or remove something from your body by sweating, usually through exercise or being in a hot place.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 운동을 하거나 뜨거운 곳에 있어 땀을 흘려 체중을 줄이거나 몸에서 무언가를 배출하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly move someone or something out of the way, often with little concern.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 어떤 것을 신속하게 옆으로 치우다, 종종 별로 신경 쓰지 않고.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone feel very strong emotions, especially excitement or love, so that they forget everything else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 매우 강한 감정, 특히 흥분이나 사랑을 느끼게 하여 모든 것을 잊게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To become larger than normal, often because of injury, illness, or a reaction to something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 부상, 질병 또는 반응으로 인해 평소보다 더 커지다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move something outward in an arc or wide motion, usually by moving your arm or hand away from your body.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 팔이나 손을 몸에서 멀리 움직여 무언가를 활 모양으로 또는 넓게 밖으로 움직이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop a machine or device from working by turning a button or switch. A more common way to say this is 'turn off'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 버튼이나 스위치를 눌러 기계나 장치의 작동을 멈추는 것. 더 일반적으로는 'turn off'를 사용합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make a machine or electronic device start working by pressing a button or turning a switch.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 버튼을 누르거나 스위치를 켜서 기계나 전자기기를 작동시키다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to change from one thing to another, especially from using or doing one thing to using or doing something different.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 한 가지에서 다른 것으로 바꾸거나, 사용하거나 하던 것을 다르게 바꾸다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To go somewhere with someone when you haven't been specifically invited, often just to be with them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특별히 초대받지 않았지만 누군가와 함께 가는 것, 주로 그들과 함께 있기 위해.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To buy prepared food or drink from a restaurant or café and take it with you to eat somewhere else. This is similar to 'take out.'
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 장소나 상황에서 제거하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to defeat or humiliate someone, especially by showing that they are not as important or skilled as they think
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 벽이나 걸려 있는 곳에서 무언가를 내리거나 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to understand or remember new information; to absorb knowledge
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 지불이나 행사에서 돈을 모으거나 받다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave the ground and begin to fly; to start flying
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가(특히 옷이나 장소·전체에서 물건)을 벗거나 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to hire or give someone a job; to employ someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 대회, 싸움, 경기 등에서 누구나 무엇에 맞서거나 도전하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remove something from a place or container.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 식사나 오락을 위해 (특히 데이트로) 초대하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start doing something that someone else was doing, or to begin to be in charge of something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람이 하던 일을 시작하거나, 무언가를 책임지게 되다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to start doing something regularly, especially as a habit or because you enjoy it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 습관적으로 또는 즐겨서 무언가를 규칙적으로 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to use or fill a particular amount of space, time, or attention.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 새로운 것(취미, 활동, 일 등)을 시작하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to say things about someone or something; to have a conversation that includes someone or something as the subject
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가에 대해 이야기하다; 누군가 또는 무언가를 주제로 대화하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to speak to someone as if they are not as smart or capable as you are; to speak in a condescending way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 상대방이 덜 똑똑하거나 능력이 없는 것처럼 내려다보며 말하다; 거만하게 말하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to persuade someone to do something, often by giving them good reasons or encouragement
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 좋은 이유나 격려로 무엇인가를 하도록 설득하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To persuade someone not to do something or to change their mind about doing something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 어떤 일을 하지 않도록 설득하거나, 생각을 바꾸도록 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to discuss something carefully, especially in order to make a decision.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 결정을 내리기 위해 어떤 것을 신중하게 상의하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to get into a fight, argument, or complicated situation with someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇과 싸움, 논쟁 또는 복잡한 상황에 얽히다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to hit or touch something lightly several times, especially with your fingers, to create a rhythm or pattern.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 손가락으로 여러 번 가볍게 두드려 리듬이나 패턴을 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to work together with someone to achieve a common goal
phrasalVerbs.ko: 공통의 목표를 달성하기 위해 누군가와 함께 일하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To pull something away quickly and forcefully, often with effort.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 힘을 들여 빠르고 강하게 떼어내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To completely destroy or remove a building or structure.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 건물이나 구조물을 완전히 부수거나 철거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to criticize someone very harshly or aggressively
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 매우 거칠고 공격적으로 비판하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to break something into small pieces by pulling it apart, usually with your hands.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 손으로 잡아 찢어서 작은 조각으로 만드는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 잘못을 해서 화를 내며 말하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to inform someone in authority about another person's bad or wrong behavior, often to get them in trouble
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 사람의 나쁜 행동을 권위자에게 알리다, 종종 그 사람이 곤란하게 하려고

phrasalVerbs.definition: to become nervous or have your muscles become tight because you are worried or anxious
phrasalVerbs.ko: 걱정하거나 불안해서 신경이 예민해지거나 근육이 경직되는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something less crowded or less thick by removing some parts or people
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 부분이나 사람을 제거하여 더 덜 붐비거나 더 덜 두껍게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remember or have someone or something in your mind; to consider someone or something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가를 기억하거나 마음에 두다; 누군가나 무언가를 고려하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to carefully plan or consider all the details of something before making a decision or taking action
phrasalVerbs.ko: 결정을 내리거나 행동하기 전에 모든 세부사항을 신중하게 계획하거나 고려하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spend some time considering something carefully before making a decision
phrasalVerbs.ko: 결정을 내리기 전에 어떤 것을 신중하게 고려하는 데 시간을 보내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to invent or imagine something, especially a new idea, excuse, or plan
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 새로운 아이디어, 변명, 계획 등을 만들어내거나 상상하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move your body wildly and uncontrollably, often because you are upset, scared, or in pain.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 당황하거나 무섭거나 아프기 때문에 몸을 격렬하고 통제 없이 움직이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get rid of something that you do not want or need anymore by putting it in the trash.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 더 이상 원하지 않거나 필요 없는 것을 쓰레기통에 버려 없애다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get rid of an illness by recovering from it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 병을 회복하여 없애다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone leave a place, such as a home, building, or event, often because they did something wrong
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 잘못을 해서 집, 건물, 행사장 등에서 내보내는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To bring food or liquid out of your stomach and through your mouth, usually because you are sick. Synonym: 'vomit'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 아플 때 음식이나 액체를 위에서 입으로 토하다. 동의어: '토하다'.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To put a mark (✓) next to something on a list to show it has been checked or completed. It is similar to 'check off'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 리스트에서 확인하거나 완료했음을 표시하기 위해 (✓) 표시를 하는 것. '체크하다'와 유사.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a place or something clean and organized by putting things in their proper place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 장소나 물건을 정리 정돈하여 깨끗하게 만드는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: To limit someone's freedom or prevent them from doing what they want.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가의 자유를 제한하거나 원하는 것을 하지 못하게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be connected or go well together with something else
phrasalVerbs.ko: 다른 것과 연결되거나 잘 어울리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To keep someone or something so busy or occupied that they cannot do anything else.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가 또는 무언가가 움직이지 못하도록 밧줄이나 끈으로 단단히 묶다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: Time off means a period when you are not working or do not have to go to school, often to rest or take care of personal things.
phrasalVerbs.ko: "time off"는 보통 휴식이나 개인적인 일 때문에 일이나 학교를 쉬는 기간을 의미합니다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To stop what you are doing and take a short break, especially to rest or calm down.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 하고 있는 일을 멈추고 짧은 휴식을 취하다, 특히 쉬거나 진정하기 위해.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to secretly give someone a warning or information, usually about something bad or illegal that is going to happen
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가에게 비밀리에 경고나 정보를 주다. 주로 나쁘거나 불법적인 일이 일어날 때 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To accidentally or purposely make someone or something fall onto its side or upside down.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 실수로 또는 일부러 옆으로 넘어뜨리거나 뒤집다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone very tired or exhausted
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 매우 피곤하게 하다; 진이 빠지게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something less strong, less forceful, or less extreme; to make something gentler or more moderate
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 덜 강하게, 덜 극단적으로 만들다; 더 부드럽거나 온건하게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make your muscles firmer, stronger, and look better by doing exercise
phrasalVerbs.ko: 운동을 통해 근육을 더 단단하고 강하게 만들어 보기 좋게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish something in a special or memorable way, especially by adding a final touch or event
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특별하거나 기억에 남는 방식으로 뭔가를 마무리하다, 특히 마지막 터치나 이벤트를 추가함으로써

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get rid of something or someone by throwing them away because you don't want or need them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 더 이상 원하지 않거나 필요하지 않아서 무언가나 누군가를 버리는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly add or include something, often casually or without much preparation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 빠르게 추가하거나 흔히 즉흥적으로 포함시키는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to mention or briefly talk about a subject in speech or writing
phrasalVerbs.ko: 연설이나 글에서 어떤 주제를 언급하거나 간단히 이야기하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make small changes or improvements to something, usually to improve its appearance or fix minor problems
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 외관을 개선하거나 작은 문제를 고치기 위해 무언가에 약간의 수정이나 개선을 하는 것

phrasalVerbs.definition: to think about or consider something casually, without making a serious decision
phrasalVerbs.ko: 심각하게 결정하지 않고 가볍게 생각하거나 고려하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to find someone or something after searching for them, especially when it is difficult.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 어렵게 누군가나 무언가를 찾아내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move from one place to another by following a specific road, path, or route
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정한 도로, 길, 경로를 따라 이동하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cause something to start suddenly, usually a series of events or a reaction.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 일련의 사건이나 반응과 같이 어떤 일의 갑작스러운 시작을 유발하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something smaller or less by removing extra parts; to reduce the size or amount of something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 불필요한 부분을 제거하여 무언가를 더 작거나 덜하게 만들다; 크기나 양을 줄이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone stumble or fall by catching their foot, or to make someone make a mistake.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가의 발을 걸어서 넘어지게 하거나, 실수를 하게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to attempt to achieve or get something, usually a prize, award, or position.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 상, 상장 또는 직위를 얻으려고 시도하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or looks good before you buy or wear it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 옷을 입어보고 맞거나 어울리는지 확인하다 (구입이나 착용 전에)

phrasalVerbs.definition: to use or do something to see if you like it or if it works well.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 팀, 그룹, 쇼의 일원이 되기 위해 경쟁하거나 오디션을 보다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To start eating food with enthusiasm, especially when you are hungry. Often used informally at mealtimes.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 배가 고플 때, 열정을 가지고 식사를 시작하다. 식사 시간에 비공식적으로 자주 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To set your radio, TV, or other device to a particular channel or station so you can listen or watch a broadcast.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 라디오, TV, 기타 기기를 특정 채널이나 방송국에 맞추어 방송을 듣거나 시청하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to change direction and go back the opposite way, or to make someone or something do this.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 방향을 바꿔 반대 방향으로 가거나, 누군가나 무언가를 그렇게 하게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move your body or face so that you are not looking at someone or something
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 장소에 들어가거나 무언가에 참여하는 것을 거부하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something, like the volume or temperature, lower or less strong
phrasalVerbs.ko: 볼륨이나 온도 등을 낮추거나 약하게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To give something to someone in authority or to the proper place, or to report someone to the authorities.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 권위자에게 제출하거나 올바른 장소에 내거나, 누군가를 당국에 신고하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone lose interest in or dislike something or someone.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 한 도로에서 나와 다른 도로로 들어서다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a device start working by switching a button or control; to start something such as a machine or light.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 처음으로 어떤 것에 관심을 갖게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to come together or gather for a public event or activity
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 대량으로 무언가를 만들거나 생산하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move someone or something so that the other side is facing up or visible
phrasalVerbs.ko: 결정하기 전에 무언가를 신중하게 생각하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To start doing or using something, especially when you need help or a solution.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 도움이 필요하거나 해결책이 필요할 때 무언가를 시작하거나 사용하기 시작하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to discover or find something unexpectedly, especially during a search or investigation.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 수색이나 조사 중에 예상치 못한 것을 발견하거나 찾아내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To be doing or involved in something (often used to ask about someone's activities).
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇을 하고 있거나 관여하고 있는 상태 (주로 누군가의 활동을 물을 때 사용됨).

phrasalVerbs.definition: To strongly encourage someone to do something or to push them to take a particular action.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가가 어떤 행동을 하도록 강하게 격려하거나 특정 행동을 하도록 밀어붙이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish or consume all of something so that nothing is left
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어떤 것을 다 써버려서 아무 것도 남지 않게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to cause or introduce something new or important, especially when starting a new period, event, or change
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 새로운 기간, 이벤트, 변화의 시작에 새로운 것이나 중요한 것을 가져오거나 도입하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to kindly guide or lead someone out of a place, such as a building or room
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 친절하게 건물이나 방 밖으로 안내하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to bring food or liquid from the stomach out through the mouth, usually because you are sick. 'Vomit up' means the same as 'throw up'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 아플 때 위에서 음식이나 액체를 입을 통해 밖으로 토하다. 'Vomit up'은 'throw up'과 같은 뜻이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To choose someone or something for a position by voting in an official election.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 공식 선거를 통해 누군가나 무언가를 직책에 선출하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to say that you believe someone or something is good, honest, or true, usually based on your own experience
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신의 경험을 바탕으로 누군가 또는 무언가가 좋고, 정직하며, 진실하다고 말하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to serve someone, especially by bringing them food or drinks in a restaurant or at home
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 식당이나 집에서 음식이나 음료를 가져다 주며 누군가를 시중들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to stop sleeping and become conscious; to make someone stop sleeping.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 잠에서 깨고 의식이 돌아오다; 누군가를 깨우다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to walk or move around a place with no special purpose or direction, often just exploring or passing time. Synonym: 'walk around'.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특별한 목적이나 방향 없이 장소를 돌아다니며 걷거나 움직이다. 주로 탐방하거나 시간을 보내는 용도. 유의어: '돌아다니다'.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a person, place, or situation by moving away, usually on foot, often because you don't want to deal with them or it anymore
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 장소, 상황을 보통 도보로 떠나 더 이상 관여하고 싶지 않을 때 사용하는 표현

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a place or situation suddenly and by walking, often without telling anyone
phrasalVerbs.ko: 허락 없이 아무도 모르게 무언가를 가져가다, 보통 그것을 들고 떠남

phrasalVerbs.definition: to leave a place or stop doing something because you are angry or do not agree with it; often used when people stop working as a form of protest (go on strike).
phrasalVerbs.ko: 화나거나 동의하지 않아 장소를 떠나거나 무언가를 그만두는 것; 주로 사람들이 항의로 일손을 놓을 때(파업을 할 때) 사용됨.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to defeat someone or something very easily, without much effort
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇을 아주 쉽게, 큰 노력 없이 이기다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To surround or enclose something or someone by building a wall around them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 벽을 세워서 누구나 무언가를 둘러싸거나 가두다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To prevent something unpleasant or dangerous from affecting you, especially by taking action.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 조치를 취하여 불쾌하거나 위험한 것이 자신에게 영향을 미치는 것을 막다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To gradually start liking someone or something, or to become more interested in them.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 점차 누군가나 어떤 것에 호감이 생기거나 더 관심을 갖게 되다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make a machine, device, or room reach a suitable or comfortable temperature before using it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 데우거나 움직여서 무언가 혹은 누군가를 더 따뜻하게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove dirt or something unwanted from a surface by using water.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물로 표면의 먼지나 원하지 않는 것을 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To drink something in order to help swallow food or medicine more easily.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 음식이나 약을 더 쉽게 삼키기 위해 무언가를 마시다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove dirt, stains, or substances from the surface of something by using water or another liquid.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물이나 다른 액체를 사용하여 표면에 있는 먼지, 얼룩, 물질을 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to remove, damage, or destroy something by the force of water
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 매우 피곤하게 만들다, 기운을 다 빼다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to clean your hands, face, or sometimes your body, usually with soap and water
phrasalVerbs.ko: (주로 영국 영어에서) 식사 후에 그릇, 컵, 커틀러리를 물과 비누로 닦다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to be careful and pay attention to possible danger or problems around you
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주변의 위험이나 문제에 주의하고 조심하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to look after or protect someone or something to make sure they are safe
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 안전하게 지키거나 돌보다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something weaker or less strong by adding water or by changing it, often to make it easier to accept or less powerful
phrasalVerbs.ko: 물을 추가하거나 변경하여 어떤 것을 약하게 하거나 덜 강하게 만드는 것, 종종 더 쉽게 받아들이도록 하거나 덜 강력하게 하려는 목적

phrasalVerbs.definition: To dismiss someone or something as not important, or to ignore them in a casual way.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 중요하지 않다고 여기거나, 무심하게 무시하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to slowly remove or reduce something by long or repeated use, rubbing, or exposure.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 오랜 사용, 반복된 마찰, 노출로 인해 무언가를 천천히 닳거나 줄어들게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To gradually make someone feel tired, weak, or less confident, or to make something become thinner or weaker by repeated use.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 점차 피곤하고 약하게 만들거나 자신감을 잃게 하거나, 반복적인 사용으로 무엇인가를 얇아지거나 약해지게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To gradually disappear or become less over time, especially after starting out strong.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 시간이 지나면서 점차 사라지거나 약해지는 것, 특히 처음에는 강하게 시작할 때.

phrasalVerbs.definition: If time wears on, it seems to pass slowly, especially when you are waiting for something or feeling bored.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 시간이 천천히 가는 것처럼 느껴질 때(특히 무언가를 기다리거나 지루할 때).

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone very tired or to use something so much that it becomes unusable.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 매우 피곤하게 만들거나, 무언가를 너무 많이 사용해서 못 쓰게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove people or things that are not wanted or not good enough from a group.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 원하지 않거나 충분히 좋지 않은 사람이나 사물을 그룹에서 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make someone feel worried, sad, or stressed because of problems or responsibilities
phrasalVerbs.ko: 문제나 책임 때문에 누군가를 걱정하거나 슬프거나 스트레스를 받게 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make someone feel worried or anxious about something for a long time.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 오랫동안 걱정하거나 불안하게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To make something or someone heavy by putting weight on them, so they can't move or are harder to move.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가나 누군가를 움직이지 못하거나 더 어렵게 움직이도록 무게를 얹어 무겁게 만들다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to suddenly start feeling a strong emotion, especially when you begin to cry or almost cry
phrasalVerbs.ko: 갑자기 강한 감정이 북받쳐 오르다, 특히 울거나 울 뻔할 때

phrasalVerbs.definition: to turn quickly to face a different direction, especially by turning your body around
phrasalVerbs.ko: 바퀴가 달린 것으로 누군가나 무언가(예: 휠체어나 카트)를 밀어서 이곳저곳으로 이동시키다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish something very quickly and easily, often without paying much attention to details
phrasalVerbs.ko: 세부 사항에 신경 쓰지 않고 아주 빠르고 쉽게 무언가를 끝내다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make or prepare something very quickly, especially food or something simple.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 음식이나 간단한 것을 아주 빠르게 만들거나 준비하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to spin or turn quickly in a circle, or to make someone or something do this
phrasalVerbs.ko: 빠르게 원을 그리며 돌다, 또는 누군가나 무언가를 그렇게 돌리다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to take someone or something somewhere quickly and suddenly, often to a different place
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇을 갑자기 빠르게 데려가거나 옮기다, 종종 다른 곳으로

phrasalVerbs.definition: to pass by someone or something very quickly and smoothly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누구나 무엇 옆을 매우 빠르고 부드럽게 지나가다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To quickly remove something from a surface or from someone, usually by brushing or wiping.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 표면이나 사람에게서 보통 털거나 닦아서 재빠르게 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gradually reduce or remove something, usually in small amounts
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 서서히, 보통 적은 양씩 줄이거나 없애다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move very quickly, especially referring to vehicles or people traveling fast.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 차량이나 사람이 매우 빠르게 이동하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to persuade someone to support you or to like your idea
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가를 설득해서 내 편을 들게 하거나 내 생각을 좋아하게 만들다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to finish or bring something, such as an event or activity, to an end
phrasalVerbs.ko: 시계와 같은 것을 작동시키기 위해 핸들이나 손잡이를 돌리다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove something, such as liquid, dirt, or tears, by gently rubbing it with your hand or a cloth.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 손이나 천으로 부드럽게 문질러 액체, 먼지, 눈물 등을 제거하는 것.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to completely destroy or remove something so that nothing is left
phrasalVerbs.ko: 아무 것도 남지 않도록 완전히 파괴하거나 제거하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To clean a surface by removing liquid or dirt with a cloth or paper towel.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 수건이나 종이 타월로 액체나 먼지를 닦아 표면을 깨끗하게 하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To eat something very quickly and often greedily, as if you are very hungry.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 매우 배고픈 것처럼 음식을 매우 빠르고 게걸스럽게 먹다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To put effort and time into improving or achieving something, usually a skill, task, or goal.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 보통 기술, 과제 또는 목표를 달성하거나 향상시키기 위해 노력과 시간을 들이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To get rid of something, like stress, fat, or a debt, by doing physical activity or hard work.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 운동이나 힘든 일을 통해 스트레스, 체지방, 빚 등을 해소하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To spend time and effort trying to improve or complete something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 향상시키거나 완성하려고 시간과 노력을 들이다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to discover or understand the answer to a problem by thinking about it.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 주로 헬스장이나 피트니스 루틴의 일부로 신체 운동을 하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to deal with or solve something that is difficult or takes time by working step by step
phrasalVerbs.ko: 어렵거나 시간이 오래 걸리는 일을 단계적으로 해결하거나 처리하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to gradually prepare yourself to achieve or do something more difficult or challenging
phrasalVerbs.ko: 더 어려운 일이나 도전에 점차 자신을 준비시키다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To cover something or someone completely, usually with paper, cloth, or another material.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 과제나 행사를 끝내거나 완성하다

phrasalVerbs.definition: To remove extra liquid from something by twisting and squeezing it tightly.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무언가를 세게 비틀고 꽉 짜서 남은 물기를 제거하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to put information on paper or in a notebook so you don't forget it
phrasalVerbs.ko: 잊지 않으려고 정보를 종이나 노트에 적다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to send a letter, email, or message to an organization or company, especially to give your opinion, ask a question, or request something.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 자신의 의견을 말하거나, 질문하거나, 무언가를 요청하기 위해 조직이나 회사에 편지, 이메일, 메시지를 보내다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to accept that something, especially money or an asset, cannot be recovered or used, usually because it has lost its value or cannot be collected
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특히 돈이나 자산이 회수되거나 사용될 수 없음을 받아들이는 것, 보통 가치가 없거나 회수가 불가능하기 때문

phrasalVerbs.definition: to create a piece of writing that is about a particular person or subject.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 특정 인물이나 주제에 대한 글을 쓰다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to write something completely and clearly, especially so that it is easy to understand or official.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 무엇인가를 완전히 그리고 명확하게 쓰다, 특히 이해하기 쉽거나 공식적으로 하기 위해.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To create a detailed written version of something, such as notes, ideas, or reports. Usually, it means organizing information and putting it clearly into writing.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 메모, 아이디어, 보고서 등을 자세히 문서로 작성하다. 보통 정보를 정리해서 명확하게 글로 옮기는 것을 의미한다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to pay very close attention to or focus specifically on a person or thing
phrasalVerbs.ko: 사람이나 사물에 매우 집중하거나 특별히 주의를 기울이다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to move past someone or something very quickly
phrasalVerbs.ko: 누군가나 무언가를 아주 빠르게 지나가다

phrasalVerbs.definition: to close something, like a jacket or a bag, using a zipper.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 재킷이나 가방과 같은 것을 지퍼로 잠그다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: To move very quickly in a vehicle, often making a lot of noise.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 차량으로 매우 빠르게, 자주 큰 소음을 내며 이동하다.

phrasalVerbs.definition: to make something appear closer or larger, especially with a camera or device, so you can see more details.
phrasalVerbs.ko: 카메라나 장치를 사용해 무언가를 더 가까이 또는 크게 보여 더 많은 세부사항을 볼 수 있게 하다.
